title: WordPress Developer for WP Rentals
description:
Bonjour,

Je recherche un développeur WordPress qui connaît WP Rentals (ou qui est capable d'apprendre rapidement).

Mon site est déjà créé. Je n'ai pas besoin de refaire le site.

Je souhaite uniquement adapter quelques fonctionnalités.

Les modifications

✅ 1. Les frais de service doivent être ajoutés au prix payé par le locataire et non retirés du montant du propriétaire.

✅ 2. Le locataire paie uniquement les frais de réservation sur le site. Le reste est payé directement au propriétaire lors de l'arrivée.

✅ 3. Ajouter un tableau de bord propriétaire indiquant :

ses gains,

ce que la plateforme lui doit,

l'historique des paiements,

un bouton "Demander un versement".

✅ 4. Après réservation, le propriétaire ne doit plus pouvoir modifier la facture. Il doit seulement confirmer la réservation.

Avant de développer

Je souhaite d'abord savoir si ces modifications peuvent être réalisées :

avec les réglages du thème,

avec des plugins,

ou si un développement est nécessaire.

Je recherche quelqu'un de sérieux, réactif, avec qui je pourrai travailler sur le long terme pour les évolutions du site.

Merci de m'indiquer :

votre expérience avec WP Rentals,

votre tarif,

et si vous pensez pouvoir réaliser ces modifications.

title: Coding & Development
description:
# Long-Term Full-Stack Developer for Existing Custom CRM – VS Code & Claude Code

We are looking for a reliable full-stack developer to help us continuously expand and improve our existing custom-built CRM system.

This is not a standard website project, a template-based CRM, or a system that needs to be built from scratch. We already have a functioning platform with a substantial codebase. The system is actively used within our company and is continuously being expanded with new features, workflows, automations, integrations, and user roles.

Our company, Subsidie Advies Nederland, helps homeowners with insulation advice, subsidy guidance, planning, and execution. You can visit **subsidieadviesnederland.nl** to get a better understanding of our business.

## About the CRM

The system supports multiple parts of our daily operation, including:

* Lead and appointment management
* Sales pipelines and customer files
* Scheduling and planning
* Advisor and back-office workflows
* Partner and contractor portals
* Document and photo management
* Invoicing and administration
* Automated emails and notifications
* Reporting, targets, and performance dashboards
* Internal task management

The current technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, tRPC, Drizzle, and MariaDB.

## What You Will Be Doing

You will work within the existing codebase and help us with:

* Developing new CRM features and modules
* Improving existing workflows and functionality
* Fixing bugs and technical issues
* Building automations and third-party integrations
* Improving usability and performance
* Testing changes before they are implemented
* Maintaining clean, stable, and understandable code
* Translating operational requirements into practical technical solutions
* Helping us make technical decisions as the system grows

We work with **VS Code and Claude Code**, so experience with AI-assisted development is important. However, we are not looking for someone who simply generates code without understanding it. You must be able to review, debug, test, and improve the code produced.

## What We Are Looking For

* Strong experience with full-stack web development
* Experience with React and TypeScript
* Experience with Node.js and backend development
* Experience working with relational databases
* Comfortable working in an existing and growing codebase
* Experience using Git and structured development workflows
* Experience with VS Code and Claude Code
* Able to work independently from clear tasks and specifications
* Proactive in identifying problems and suggesting improvements
* Good communication in English
* Careful with production systems and customer data
* Available for multiple hours per week on an ongoing basis

Experience with CRM systems, workflow automation, API integrations, email systems, invoicing software, or AI-assisted development is a strong advantage.

## Long-Term Collaboration

We are specifically looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration. There is already a substantial amount of work available, and the platform will continue to grow alongside the company.

We prefer to build a stable working relationship with one developer who learns our system and business processes, rather than repeatedly hiring different people for individual tasks.

The number of weekly hours can grow if the collaboration works well.

## How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. Your experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and databases
2. Your experience working on existing CRM or business-management systems
3. How you currently use Claude Code or other AI coding tools
4. Your weekly availability
5. Examples of relevant projects or code
6. Your time zone
7. How you normally test and verify AI-generated code

Please start your proposal with the word **“SAN”** so we know you have read the complete description.

⚠️ Mandatory Terms & Ownership:
100% Client Ownership: Domain registration, cloud hosting, database, and all admin credentials (IDs & Passwords) must be registered strictly under my official email ID.

6 Months Maintenance: Minimum 6 months of post-launch bug-fixing and technical support included.

🗓️ Proposed Execution Timeline (15 Days):
Phase 1 (Days 1–3): Hosting/Domain Setup (on my email), Branding Kit, UI/UX Mockups.

Phase 2 (Days 4–8): 5-Page WordPress Frontend, Payment Gateway & Client Upload Form.

Your All-Inclusive Fixed Budget Quote (in INR) for the complete scope.

Confirmation of the 15-day timeline (or your proposed delivery schedule).

Past Work Samples or links to similar custom portals/applications built by you.

Looking forward to discussing this and getting started soon.

Best regards,

Abhishek K. Kesarwani (Advocate)

title: Custom Laravel Live-Stream Wheel Game Developer Needed
description:
I am looking for an experienced Laravel full-stack developer to build a custom interactive wheel game inside my existing live-stream platform.

The game will be similar in concept to the reference provided, but it must use our own original design, branding, rules, graphics, and controls. It must not copy another company’s copyrighted interface or assets.

PROJECT GOAL

Customers should be able to watch the live stream and participate in the wheel game directly from the same mobile-responsive screen. The game must not redirect customers to another website or a separate game page.

PHASE 1 REQUIREMENTS

The first version should include:

- Three selectable choices, such as Blue Fish, Orange Fish, and Red Fish
- An animated spinning wheel
- A countdown timer before each round
- Customer play-amount selection
- Confirm, repeat, clear, and undo controls
- One shared official result for every customer
- Automatic reward calculation
- Automatic customer balance updates
- Basic admin controls
- Round and transaction logs
- Mobile-responsive design
- Integration into our existing live-stream platform

CUSTOMER GAME FLOW

1. The customer enters the live stream.
2. The wheel and available choices appear on the screen.
3. A countdown gives customers time to make their selections.
4. The customer selects one or more choices and enters a play amount.
5. The customer confirms the selection.
6. The system checks the available balance and deducts the confirmed amount.
7. When the countdown ends, all new selections are automatically closed.
8. The wheel spins for everyone watching.
9. Every customer receives the same official result.
10. The system calculates the result and automatically updates each customer’s balance.
11. The result screen displays the winning choice, multiplier, play amount, reward, updated balance, and round ID.

ADMIN CONTROLS

Authorized Admins and Super Admins should be able to:

- Start and stop the game
- Start a new round
- Set the countdown duration
- Set the time between rounds
- Add, remove, rename, enable, or disable wheel choices
- Upload an image or icon for each choice
- Set multipliers or reward values
- Set minimum and maximum play amounts
- View customer selections
- View the total amount placed on each choice
- View round results
- Cancel and refund a round when necessary
- View round and transaction history
- Set a configurable platform percentage

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

- The official result must be generated securely on the server.
- Every customer must receive the same result.
- Customers cannot submit after the countdown ends.
- Customers cannot spend more than their available balance.
- Confirmed selections cannot be edited.
- The system must prevent duplicate submissions and duplicate rewards.
- Refreshing the page must not allow a customer to submit twice.
- Every balance change must be recorded in the transaction logs.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

The existing platform uses Laravel. The developer should have experience with:

- Laravel
- PHP
- JavaScript
- HTML5 Canvas or a suitable animation library
- MySQL
- APIs
- WebSockets or real-time communication
- Secure balance and transaction systems
- Mobile-responsive interfaces

DELIVERABLES

- Complete working game feature
- Integration into our existing platform
- Mobile-responsive customer interface
- Admin controls
- Database and transaction logging
- Testing and bug fixes
- Installation on our server
- Documentation explaining how the system works
- All completed work merged into our existing GitLab project
- All required code, database migrations, templates, assets, package changes, and setup instructions included in our repository
- No essential part of the game may depend on the developer’s private repository, computer, hosting account, or server

Please include the following in your proposal:

- Relevant Laravel or real-time game experience
- Examples of similar work
- Your proposed development approach
- Estimated completion time
- Your fixed-price quote for Phase 1
- Confirmation that all completed work will be merged into our GitLab project

description:
Laravel Developer: Audit & Complete API for Event Organization Platform (MVP)
Overview

We have an existing Laravel-based event organization system with a partially built API. We need an experienced Laravel developer to audit the current API, identify gaps against our MVP requirements, and build out the missing flows so the platform is fully functional and ready for launch.

This is not a from-scratch build — the core Laravel app and API already exist. We need someone who can quickly get up to speed on an existing codebase, spot what's broken/missing/inconsistent, and ship clean, production-ready fixes and features.

What We Need Done

Phase 1 — API Audit

title: Custom Laravel Live-Stream Wheel Game Developer Needed
description:
I am looking for an experienced Laravel full-stack developer to build a custom interactive wheel game inside my existing live-stream platform.

The game will be similar in concept to the reference provided, but it must use our own original design, branding, rules, graphics, and controls. It must not copy another company’s copyrighted interface or assets.

PROJECT GOAL

Customers should be able to watch the live stream and participate in the wheel game directly from the same mobile-responsive screen. The game must not redirect customers to another website or a separate game page.

PHASE 1 REQUIREMENTS

The first version should include:

- Three selectable choices, such as Blue Fish, Orange Fish, and Red Fish
- An animated spinning wheel
- A countdown timer before each round
- Customer play-amount selection
- Confirm, repeat, clear, and undo controls
- One shared official result for every customer
- Automatic reward calculation
- Automatic customer balance updates
- Basic admin controls
- Round and transaction logs
- Mobile-responsive design
- Integration into our existing live-stream platform

CUSTOMER GAME FLOW

1. The customer enters the live stream.
2. The wheel and available choices appear on the screen.
3. A countdown gives customers time to make their selections.
4. The customer selects one or more choices and enters a play amount.
5. The customer confirms the selection.
6. The system checks the available balance and deducts the confirmed amount.
7. When the countdown ends, all new selections are automatically closed.
8. The wheel spins for everyone watching.
9. Every customer receives the same official result.
10. The system calculates the result and automatically updates each customer’s balance.
11. The result screen displays the winning choice, multiplier, play amount, reward, updated balance, and round ID.

ADMIN CONTROLS

Authorized Admins and Super Admins should be able to:

- Start and stop the game
- Start a new round
- Set the countdown duration
- Set the time between rounds
- Add, remove, rename, enable, or disable wheel choices
- Upload an image or icon for each choice
- Set multipliers or reward values
- Set minimum and maximum play amounts
- View customer selections
- View the total amount placed on each choice
- View round results
- Cancel and refund a round when necessary
- View round and transaction history
- Set a configurable platform percentage

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

- The official result must be generated securely on the server.
- Every customer must receive the same result.
- Customers cannot submit after the countdown ends.
- Customers cannot spend more than their available balance.
- Confirmed selections cannot be edited.
- The system must prevent duplicate submissions and duplicate rewards.
- Refreshing the page must not allow a customer to submit twice.
- Every balance change must be recorded in the transaction logs.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

The existing platform uses Laravel. The developer should have experience with:

- Laravel
- PHP
- JavaScript
- HTML5 Canvas or a suitable animation library
- MySQL
- APIs
- WebSockets or real-time communication
- Secure balance and transaction systems
- Mobile-responsive interfaces

DELIVERABLES

- Complete working game feature
- Integration into our existing platform
- Mobile-responsive customer interface
- Admin controls
- Database and transaction logging
- Testing and bug fixes
- Installation on our server
- Documentation explaining how the system works
- All completed work merged into our existing GitLab project
- All required code, database migrations, templates, assets, package changes, and setup instructions included in our repository
- No essential part of the game may depend on the developer’s private repository, computer, hosting account, or server

Please include the following in your proposal:

- Relevant Laravel or real-time game experience
- Examples of similar work
- Your proposed development approach
- Estimated completion time
- Your fixed-price quote for Phase 1
- Confirmation that all completed work will be merged into our GitLab project

title: WooCommerce / Cloudflare help - card testing attacks on checkout
description:
Hey there,

We run a smaller family business on WooCommerce and recently got hit with an automated card-testing attack hitting our checkout endpoint (/?wc-ajax=checkout). It caused server spikes, database bloat, and temporary checkout errors for real customers.

We tried setting up some Cloudflare rules ourselves to stop it, but we need an experienced WooCommerce / Cloudflare specialist to get the WAF rules and rate limiting dialed in properly.

Here is where we are at right now:

We have Cloudflare Turnstile installed, but bots are bypassing the visual page and hitting the AJAX checkout endpoint directly.

We set up a basic Cloudflare rate limit for wc-ajax=checkout, but it’s logging 0 hits—so the expression or threshold is definitely off.

We have verified bots (Googlebot, Bingbot) set to allow/skip, which we need to keep intact so our search rankings aren't affected.

What we need help with:

Fix/configure our Cloudflare WAF and rate limiting so direct requests to /checkout/ and wc-ajax=checkout are challenged or blocked at the network edge before hitting our server.

Ensure search engine crawlers (Googlebot/Bingbot) remain 100% exempted from any new rules or challenges.

Check our Stripe Radar / velocity settings to block rapid card attempts from the same IP or session.

Safely clean up the database junk left behind from the attack (orphaned sessions, failed orders) without touching active carts.

Do a quick test on our checkout script execution to confirm payment gateways and discounts trigger cleanly without console errors.

While you are in there, please let me know if you spot any obvious WooCommerce caching misconfigurations, JavaScript conflicts, or PHP worker limits that might be compounding the checkout slowdown.  We are looking for a one time project to get this done permanently. 

Thanks

title: Coding & Development
description:
# Long-Term Full-Stack Developer for Existing Custom CRM – VS Code & Claude Code

We are looking for a reliable full-stack developer to help us continuously expand and improve our existing custom-built CRM system.

This is not a standard website project, a template-based CRM, or a system that needs to be built from scratch. We already have a functioning platform with a substantial codebase. The system is actively used within our company and is continuously being expanded with new features, workflows, automations, integrations, and user roles.

Our company, Subsidie Advies Nederland, helps homeowners with insulation advice, subsidy guidance, planning, and execution. You can visit **subsidieadviesnederland.nl** to get a better understanding of our business.

## About the CRM

The system supports multiple parts of our daily operation, including:

* Lead and appointment management
* Sales pipelines and customer files
* Scheduling and planning
* Advisor and back-office workflows
* Partner and contractor portals
* Document and photo management
* Invoicing and administration
* Automated emails and notifications
* Reporting, targets, and performance dashboards
* Internal task management

The current technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, tRPC, Drizzle, and MariaDB.

## What You Will Be Doing

You will work within the existing codebase and help us with:

* Developing new CRM features and modules
* Improving existing workflows and functionality
* Fixing bugs and technical issues
* Building automations and third-party integrations
* Improving usability and performance
* Testing changes before they are implemented
* Maintaining clean, stable, and understandable code
* Translating operational requirements into practical technical solutions
* Helping us make technical decisions as the system grows

We work with **VS Code and Claude Code**, so experience with AI-assisted development is important. However, we are not looking for someone who simply generates code without understanding it. You must be able to review, debug, test, and improve the code produced.

## What We Are Looking For

* Strong experience with full-stack web development
* Experience with React and TypeScript
* Experience with Node.js and backend development
* Experience working with relational databases
* Comfortable working in an existing and growing codebase
* Experience using Git and structured development workflows
* Experience with VS Code and Claude Code
* Able to work independently from clear tasks and specifications
* Proactive in identifying problems and suggesting improvements
* Good communication in English
* Careful with production systems and customer data
* Available for multiple hours per week on an ongoing basis

Experience with CRM systems, workflow automation, API integrations, email systems, invoicing software, or AI-assisted development is a strong advantage.

## Long-Term Collaboration

We are specifically looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration. There is already a substantial amount of work available, and the platform will continue to grow alongside the company.

We prefer to build a stable working relationship with one developer who learns our system and business processes, rather than repeatedly hiring different people for individual tasks.

The number of weekly hours can grow if the collaboration works well.

## How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. Your experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and databases
2. Your experience working on existing CRM or business-management systems
3. How you currently use Claude Code or other AI coding tools
4. Your weekly availability
5. Examples of relevant projects or code
6. Your time zone
7. How you normally test and verify AI-generated code

Please start your proposal with the word **“SAN”** so we know you have read the complete description.

title: Custom Laravel Live-Stream Wheel Game Developer Needed
description:
I am looking for an experienced Laravel full-stack developer to build a custom interactive wheel game inside my existing live-stream platform.

The game will be similar in concept to the reference provided, but it must use our own original design, branding, rules, graphics, and controls. It must not copy another company’s copyrighted interface or assets.

PROJECT GOAL

Customers should be able to watch the live stream and participate in the wheel game directly from the same mobile-responsive screen. The game must not redirect customers to another website or a separate game page.

PHASE 1 REQUIREMENTS

The first version should include:

- Three selectable choices, such as Blue Fish, Orange Fish, and Red Fish
- An animated spinning wheel
- A countdown timer before each round
- Customer play-amount selection
- Confirm, repeat, clear, and undo controls
- One shared official result for every customer
- Automatic reward calculation
- Automatic customer balance updates
- Basic admin controls
- Round and transaction logs
- Mobile-responsive design
- Integration into our existing live-stream platform

CUSTOMER GAME FLOW

1. The customer enters the live stream.
2. The wheel and available choices appear on the screen.
3. A countdown gives customers time to make their selections.
4. The customer selects one or more choices and enters a play amount.
5. The customer confirms the selection.
6. The system checks the available balance and deducts the confirmed amount.
7. When the countdown ends, all new selections are automatically closed.
8. The wheel spins for everyone watching.
9. Every customer receives the same official result.
10. The system calculates the result and automatically updates each customer’s balance.
11. The result screen displays the winning choice, multiplier, play amount, reward, updated balance, and round ID.

ADMIN CONTROLS

Authorized Admins and Super Admins should be able to:

- Start and stop the game
- Start a new round
- Set the countdown duration
- Set the time between rounds
- Add, remove, rename, enable, or disable wheel choices
- Upload an image or icon for each choice
- Set multipliers or reward values
- Set minimum and maximum play amounts
- View customer selections
- View the total amount placed on each choice
- View round results
- Cancel and refund a round when necessary
- View round and transaction history
- Set a configurable platform percentage

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

- The official result must be generated securely on the server.
- Every customer must receive the same result.
- Customers cannot submit after the countdown ends.
- Customers cannot spend more than their available balance.
- Confirmed selections cannot be edited.
- The system must prevent duplicate submissions and duplicate rewards.
- Refreshing the page must not allow a customer to submit twice.
- Every balance change must be recorded in the transaction logs.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

The existing platform uses Laravel. The developer should have experience with:

- Laravel
- PHP
- JavaScript
- HTML5 Canvas or a suitable animation library
- MySQL
- APIs
- WebSockets or real-time communication
- Secure balance and transaction systems
- Mobile-responsive interfaces

DELIVERABLES

- Complete working game feature
- Integration into our existing platform
- Mobile-responsive customer interface
- Admin controls
- Database and transaction logging
- Testing and bug fixes
- Installation on our server
- Documentation explaining how the system works
- All completed work merged into our existing GitLab project
- All required code, database migrations, templates, assets, package changes, and setup instructions included in our repository
- No essential part of the game may depend on the developer’s private repository, computer, hosting account, or server

Please include the following in your proposal:

- Relevant Laravel or real-time game experience
- Examples of similar work
- Your proposed development approach
- Estimated completion time
- Your fixed-price quote for Phase 1
- Confirmation that all completed work will be merged into our GitLab project

title: WooCommerce / Cloudflare help - card testing attacks on checkout
description:
Hey there,

We run a smaller family business on WooCommerce and recently got hit with an automated card-testing attack hitting our checkout endpoint (/?wc-ajax=checkout). It caused server spikes, database bloat, and temporary checkout errors for real customers.

We tried setting up some Cloudflare rules ourselves to stop it, but we need an experienced WooCommerce / Cloudflare specialist to get the WAF rules and rate limiting dialed in properly.

Here is where we are at right now:

We have Cloudflare Turnstile installed, but bots are bypassing the visual page and hitting the AJAX checkout endpoint directly.

We set up a basic Cloudflare rate limit for wc-ajax=checkout, but it’s logging 0 hits—so the expression or threshold is definitely off.

We have verified bots (Googlebot, Bingbot) set to allow/skip, which we need to keep intact so our search rankings aren't affected.

What we need help with:

Fix/configure our Cloudflare WAF and rate limiting so direct requests to /checkout/ and wc-ajax=checkout are challenged or blocked at the network edge before hitting our server.

Ensure search engine crawlers (Googlebot/Bingbot) remain 100% exempted from any new rules or challenges.

Check our Stripe Radar / velocity settings to block rapid card attempts from the same IP or session.

Safely clean up the database junk left behind from the attack (orphaned sessions, failed orders) without touching active carts.

Do a quick test on our checkout script execution to confirm payment gateways and discounts trigger cleanly without console errors.

While you are in there, please let me know if you spot any obvious WooCommerce caching misconfigurations, JavaScript conflicts, or PHP worker limits that might be compounding the checkout slowdown.  We are looking for a one time project to get this done permanently. 

Thanks

title: AI Software Developer for MVP
description:
AI Software Developer Needed — Build an MVP for an AI-Powered Hiring Optimization Platform
Project Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI software developer to build the MVP of an innovative SaaS platform called the Hiring Optimization Machine (HOM).
HOM is an AI-enhanced Skill Intelligence Platform designed to help organizations make better hiring decisions------ rather than relying solely on traditional keyword matching or rigid checklist-based assessments.
Primary Objective
Develop a production-quality, scalable MVP quickly and cost-effectively by leveraging existing frontier AI models and APIs.
The successful developer should prioritize:
•	Contribute to rapid MVP development
•	Cost-effective development and infrastructure
•	High-quality, scalable architecture
•	Clean, modular, and maintainable code
•	Strong security and data-handling practices
•	Flexibility to support multiple AI providers in the future
•	Well-documented and independently testable components

The HOM MVP is designed as a modular SaaS platform consisting of nine core modules. Each module has clearly defined objectives, functional requirements, development tasks, acceptance criteria, and technical deliverables.
To accelerate development, reduce project risk, and support parallel implementation, the modules may be assigned to different developers. Each developer will be responsible for delivering modules that are:
•	Fully functional
•	Well documented
•	Independently testable
•	Secure and maintainable
•	Compatible with the overall platform architecture
•	Designed to integrate seamlessly with other HOM modules
Each completed module will be reviewed by independent technical evaluators to assess code quality, functional performance, architecture, documentation, security, scalability, and compliance with the established technical requirements.
To further accelerate development and improve cost efficiency, we intend to use AI-powered software development tools, including Devin, where appropriate. Developers should be comfortable working with AI-assisted development tools and incorporating them into an efficient, well-governed software development workflow.

title: Client Collaboration Portal for a Custom Travel Agency
description:
We're a custom travel agency looking for someone to build a client collaboration portal (web applicaiton). Today we plan trips in Travel Joy and collaborate with clients over email, phone, and copy-pasted Google Sheets, which leaves no record of what was agreed and no way for clients to respond to what we propose. We need a portal where each itinerary item — hotel, flight, activity, transfer — carries an approval status: the client either approves it or requests a change with a required comment, we're notified, we make the edit, and a client-visible revision log shows what changed. Behind that we need a CRM for clients and trips, an itinerary builder with typed items and a reusable template library, planner-to-client messaging, notifications, and branded PDF output. Two requirements rule out most platforms: 1. no per-user pricing for clients, we may be planning 100+ trips at a time and a group trip can have 50+ travelers who each need a login to submit their own passport and preference details (i.e., we may have 5,000+ people on the portal at once or), and 2. two-axis record permissions enforced server-side, where everyone on a trip sees the shared itinerary but each traveler sees only their own room and flights, never another traveler's. We haven't picked a platform, but Stacker.ai, Noloco, and Softr have major limitations so more than likely a vibe code/no code platform will not work, and CMS’s like Wordpress also cannot render the capabilities we need. We do have a dedicated enterprise architecture resource on our team that tested this but also does not have the bandwidth to fully architect a platform and implement, so we have a full spec ready below covering the data model, permission matrix, and build phases. 

⭐Please read full spec attachment to learn more about this project

Problem: Our current itinerary tool has no way for clients to give us structured feedback. So when we propose a hotel or a day plan, the response comes back by phone, email, or a copy-pasted spreadsheet. There's no approval status, no record of what changed or why, and no single place either side can look to see where things stand. On a trip with dozens of moving parts, that costs us hours per client and creates real risk of something being missed.

What we need:

A client-facing portal with:

- A CRM: holding client records, trips, travel preferences, and trip history
- An itinerary builder: with typed items including lodging, flights, activities, transfers, restaurants, cruises, rail, car rental — each with its own fields, plus a library of reusable blocks our planners can drop into any trip
- An approval workflow: where each itinerary item moves through In Progress → Pending Approval → Approved, or gets sent back as Change Requested with a mandatory comment explaining why
- A revision log: clients can see, so after we make a change they know exactly what changed
- Comments and messaging: between planners and clients, on individual items and generally
- Notifications: in-app and by email, with the ability to turn email off per event type
- Branded PDF output: of the final itinerary, generated from the portal data

These are non-negotiable and they rule out several popular platforms:

1. **No per-user pricing for clients.** A single group trip can have 50+ travelers, each needing their own login to submit passport details and travel preferences. Per-seat pricing for external users doesn't work for us at any tier.

2. **Two-axis record permissions, enforced server-side.** Everyone on a trip sees the shared day-by-day itinerary. But each traveler sees only *their own* room assignment, flights, and personal data — not the other 49 travelers'. This has to be enforced at the data layer, not by hiding elements in the interface.

Required experience

● 6+ years building and shipping production web applications end to end
● 3+ years specifically on multi-tenant applications where different users see different subsets of the same data — client portals, SaaS platforms, marketplaces, healthcare or legal software, or similar
● Demonstrated experience designing and implementing authorization models, not just authentication. You've built systems where "which records can this user see" was a hard problem, and you can talk about how you solved it
● Experience handling PII in production — passport data, dates of birth, payment references — including encryption at rest, access logging, and least-privilege design

Core technical skills

● Strong backend proficiency in one of: Laravel/PHP, Ruby on Rails, Django/Python, or Node/TypeScript. We're stack-agnostic and will defer to your recommendation, but you should be deeply fluent in whichever you propose rather than learning it on our project
● Relational database design — normalized schema, indexing, migrations. PostgreSQL preferred
● Row-level authorization implemented at the data layer. Postgres RLS, policy objects (Pundit/CanCanCan), Laravel Policies and Gates, Django Guardian, or an equivalent approach you can defend
● Modern frontend: React, Vue, or a server-rendered equivalent (Inertia, Hotwire, Livewire). The interface needs to be genuinely good — planners use it daily and clients judge us by it
● Role-based access control with field-level granularity, not just page-level gating
● Audit logging and change tracking — PaperTrail, django-simple-history, Laravel Auditing, or a custom implementation. We need a client-visible record of what changed on each itinerary item
● REST/webhook integrations: Stripe, JotForm, Kit (ConvertKit)
● Transactional email at production quality — Postmark, SES, or SendGrid, with deliverability configured properly
● Server-side PDF generation from application data with real design fidelity (Puppeteer, Playwright, WeasyPrint, or a rendering service)
● File upload and storage with access control — S3 or equivalent, with signed URLs
● Deployment, environments, and CI/CD. You own staging and production, not just the codebase

Nice to have

● Supabase or similar experience, particularly with Postgres Row-Level Security
● Prior work in travel, hospitality, events, or another domain with group bookings and per-participant data
● Experience with document generation templates at scale
● Background in security review or penetration testing
● Comfort with SOC 2 vendor requirements and compliance documentation

What we're not looking for

● No-code or low-code implementers. We evaluated Stacker, Noloco, and WordPress and decided against them for this build

title: Front end WordPress site design update
description:
I have a site that is built on WordPress - www.alarmion.com, hosted on Cloudways, using WooCommerce with Stripe for payments. The back end is done. What's missing is a front end that actually looks good. The current front end needs to be redone. This isn't a small patch job, it's a real rebuild.

I like the feel of this reference site: https://alarmion-pitch.vercel.app (We cannot copy this exact reference as it is JUST for reference). It uses a scrolling hero section, full screen scenes that fade into each other as you scroll, a nav bar that stays pinned at the top, and a clean dark navy look. After that it has normal sections: pricing, how it works, coverage area, FAQ, footer.

To be clear, the final site does not need to look identical to that reference. It's there to show you the level of polish and style I'm going for, not something to trace exactly. If you have a better idea for how to hit that same feel in WordPress, I want to hear it.

One important detail about the product. We already have a shopping cart and payment section built into the back end, using WooCommerce with Stripe for payments. Right now it's not styled to match the rest of the site. We want the front end work to cover that too, so if we do start taking real paid pre-orders, the cart and checkout pages look just as polished as everything else, not like a bolted on afterthought. If the payment flow isn't turned on yet when you're working on this, style it as if it will be live soon, don't assume it can stay rough because "it's not being used yet."

Scope of Work
- Rebuild the front end to a modern, professional standard, using the reference site as a style benchmark, not a copy
- Build a scroll based hero section (if possible) or another polished visual treatment for the homepage. If a full scroll animation isn't realistic for the budget, tell me what you'd recommend instead
- Style the existing WooCommerce cart and checkout pages (payments run through Stripe) to match the new look. The functionality is already built, this is a visual pass, not new development, but it needs to feel like part of the same site, not a separate system bolted on
- Build or clean up a simple lead capture option too, for anyone who wants to be notified before pre-orders open, name and email at minimum
- Rebuild the supporting sections: pricing and plans, how it works, coverage or service area list, FAQ, closing call to action
- Footer needs to include Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, and a link to the FAQ, plus basic contact and company info. These pages can be simple but they need to exist
- Full responsiveness across phone, tablet, and desktop. Any scroll animation needs to simplify gracefully on mobile, no clunky scroll jacking on phones
- Cross browser check, Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge
- SEO needs to be a real priority, not an afterthought. Proper meta titles and descriptions, clean semantic HTML, alt text on images, clean URLs, fast load times, mobile friendly, basic schema markup where it makes sense. Tell me in your proposal what tools or plugins you'd use and what "SEO friendly" actually means in your process
- Reasonable performance. Compressed images, no layout shift, fast load times

Ongoing Iteration
This won't be a one and done delivery. Expect at least one round, probably a few, of feedback and fixes after the first version as we compare it against the reference site and my own notes. Please build in some room for revisions rather than treating the first draft as final.

What I'll Provide
- Admin access to my WordPress site
- Brand assets: logo, color palette, fonts already picked
- Real photography or renders where I have them, hoping we can AI build other assets as needed and that you know how to do this
- The reference site link to compare against as you go

Required Skills
- WordPress, comfortable in Custom HTML blocks, Elementor, Divi, Bricks, or custom page templates, whichever fits best
- HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, able to read and build on hand written code, not just drag and drop in a page builder
- PHP, enough to work with WordPress under the hood, not just the front end
- Responsive design, mobile first troubleshooting since any scroll or visual effects need to behave differently or simplify on small screens
- SEO fundamentals, meta tags, semantic markup, image alt text, page speed, comfortable with a plugin like Yoast or RankMath
- Comfortable styling an existing WooCommerce cart and checkout (Stripe for payments) to match a custom design, and separately, setting up a simple lead capture form
- Familiar with Cloudways hosting, or general comfort with cloud WordPress hosting environments
- Image optimization, compressing and serving photos without killing load time
- A good eye for visual detail. Spacing, type, color consistency. I need this to look genuinely good, not just functional
- Fluent in English. We'll be communicating back and forth throughout this project and I need that to be smooth

Nice to Have
- Experience with scroll based animation, position sticky, IntersectionObserver, requestAnimationFrame, or libraries like GSAP ScrollTrigger or Lenis
- A portfolio with at least one scroll animated or "storytelling" style site
- Experience with dark themed, modern SaaS style marketing sites
- Comfort with page speed tools like PageSpeed Insights or Lighthouse
- Basic accessibility awareness, readable contrast, a prefers reduced motion fallback

Budget and Timeline
Fixed price, $200 or less. Tell me your proposed timeline in your application based on the scope above. 

How to Apply
A few things I want in your proposal:

1. A link to a live site you've built, ideally something with strong visual polish or motion design, even if it's not the same style as this project
2. Whether you prefer Custom HTML blocks or a page builder like Elementor, and why
3. Your own proposed approach and timeline for this project

One more thing. Please write your proposal yourself. I'm fine with you using AI to help polish your writing, fix grammar, tighten up your wording, that's normal and expected. What I don't want is a proposal that reads like it was generated wholesale by AI with no real thought behind it. I want to hear from you, in your own words, about how you'd approach this project.

To confirm you read this whole post, start your proposal with the word ALARM.

Looking for someone who can move fast, communicate clearly, and actually cares about how the finished product looks. Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: XenForo 2.3 AI-Powered RSS Summarizer and Thread Importer Add-on
description:
I need a custom XenForo 2.3 add-on that imports RSS feeds, retrieves each linked article, uses AI to generate a concise summary, and creates a normal XenForo discussion thread.

The website name and subject matter are confidential and should not be mentioned publicly. The site currently uses three RSS feeds and may add more later.

Required workflow

For each new RSS item, the add-on should:

Read the RSS entry and original article URL.
Fetch the linked article page.
Extract the main article text while removing menus, ads, related-content sections, navigation, footers, and other page clutter.
Send the cleaned article text to an AI provider.
Generate a neutral, factual summary of approximately 75–125 words.
Create a standard XenForo discussion thread in the selected forum.
Use the original article headline as the thread title.
Apply the thread prefix assigned to that feed.
Include the AI summary, source attribution, and original article link.
End the post with: “Discuss this story below.”
Prevent duplicate imports using the RSS GUID, canonical URL, or both.

The resulting post should look approximately like this:

[AI-generated summary of approximately 75–125 words.]

Source: [Source name]
[Link to the full article]

Discuss this story below.

Admin CP options

The add-on should allow configuration of:

RSS feed URL
Source name
Destination forum
Thread prefix
Enable or disable each feed
AI provider
AI API key
AI model
Summary length
Editable AI prompt
Feed-check frequency
Maximum articles imported per run
Post immediately or place in moderation
Configurable fallback template

OpenAI support is required. OpenRouter support would be useful if it does not add significant cost or complexity.

Failure handling

If an article cannot be retrieved or summarized, the add-on should:

retry during a later cron run; or
create a link-only post using a configurable fallback template.

It must not create duplicate threads after a failed or repeated attempt.

Logging

A basic Admin CP log should show:

successfully imported
skipped as duplicate
article retrieval failed
AI request failed
awaiting retry
fallback post created
Development requirements
Must be a properly packaged XenForo 2.3 add-on.
Must use XenForo’s standard entities, services, options, permissions, and cron system.
Do not create threads through improvised direct database inserts.
API credentials must be stored appropriately.
The add-on must be suitable for future XenForo updates.
Complete source code must be provided.
I must have the right to continue using and modifying the add-on.
The site name, URL, feed sources, and project details must remain confidential.

Please provide:

examples of XenForo add-ons you have developed
estimated or fixed price
expected completion time
testing and support terms
any recommended changes to this approach

title: Luxury WordPress Agency Site (Duke & Duchess Reference) + Gravity Forms Vetting Engine
description:
'Job Overview
We are looking for an expert WordPress developer to build a clean, high-end, responsive agency website for Belgravia & Co., an elite domestic staffing agency based in Mayfair.
The front-end design, editorial layout, and visual presentation must directly mirror the aesthetic of Duke & Duchess International (crisp typography, spacious luxury layouts, ivory/black/gold palette).
Technical Stack & Constraints
 Theme Framework: GeneratePress Pro using standard WordPress Gutenberg block containers. (Strictly no heavy page builders like Elementor or Divi to maintain maximum speed).
 Form Engine: Gravity Forms Pro + ACF Pro.
 Security & Performance: Zero-footprint file uploads, lightweight CSS, and full mobile responsiveness.
Project Scope & Core Deliverables
1. Full Front-End Architecture (10+ Marketing Pages)
Build out the complete editorial site layout based on the Duke & Duchess reference structure:
 Home Page: High-end hero section, agency positioning, service overview blocks, and CTA triggers.
 Our Story / About: Heritage, methodology, and agency philosophy.
 Services (4 Dedicated Landing Pages):
 Childcare & Education
 Private Household Staff
 Family Office & Corporate Staff
 Maternity & Newborn Care
 Process Pages: The Approach & The Benchmark (candidate vetting standards).
 Insights / Blog: Clean article index layout and post templates.
 Live Roles / Job Board: Active listings page configured to pass URL parameters into forms.
 Contact Us: Location details and discreet inquiry handling.
2. Gravity Forms Technical Engine
 Candidate Intake Gate ("Join Our Network"): A multi-step AJAX form supporting 6 distinct career tracks (Estate Manager, Butler/Housekeeper, Private Chef, Norland Nanny, Close Protection, Superyacht Crew).
 Scoring & Routing Engine: A 4-stage progress bar with conditional branch logic, a hidden scoring accumulator field, and 3-tier outcome routing (Top Tier, Reserve, Below Threshold).
 Zero-Footprint CV Upload Security: Score-gated CV uploads (PDF/DOC) attached directly to admin notification emails and immediately unlinked/deleted from the server via a ⁠gform_after_submission⁠ PHP hook (zero permanent server footprint).
 Client Intake Engine ("Start a Hire"): Multi-step AJAX lead capture form with branded HTML email routing.
 Live Adverts Infrastructure: Parameter-based hidden fields (⁠?role=x⁠) with cloneable field block templates and a short Loom/PDF guide for internal team use.
Budget & Terms
 Contract Type: Fixed-Price Contract
 Total Fixed Budget: £500 GBP ($650 USD)
 Timeline: 2 to 3 weeks
To Apply:
Please confirm in your response:
1. You accept the £500 GBP / $650 USD fixed-price budget.
2. You agree to build strictly on GeneratePress Pro without Elementor.
3. You have proven experience with Gravity Forms conditional logic, hidden scoring, and PHP hooks (⁠unlink()⁠).
4. Share 2 or 3 examples of luxury, editorial, or agency WordPress sites you have built.
'

title: Website Manager for WordPress/Elementor
description:
Senior WooCommerce Developer Needed for Custom Website & Advanced Functionality

We are looking for an experienced **Senior WordPress/WooCommerce Developer** with a proven track record of building high-quality, custom websites and complex WooCommerce solutions.

The first assignment is to **take over an existing project** and successfully complete it. We are looking for someone who can quickly understand an existing codebase, identify issues, and deliver a professional result.

Requirements

* Extensive experience with **WordPress** and **WooCommerce**
* Proven portfolio of custom WooCommerce projects
* Strong PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and MySQL skills
* Experience building **custom WooCommerce functionality**
* Ability to develop **custom plugins and integrations**
* Experience creating **product configurators**
* Experience building **workflow automations** and API integrations
* Able to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and proactive attitude

The project

This is a technical WooCommerce website that requires custom development. It is **not** a standard website built with page builders.

Your first task will be to:

* Review the existing project
* Complete the remaining development
* Fix outstanding issues
* Build additional custom functionality where required
* Develop a custom product configurator
* Create automations and integrations with external systems

What we're looking for

We want to work with a developer who:

* Can work independently
* Thinks in solutions instead of problems
* Has experience with complex WooCommerce projects
* Can provide realistic timelines
* Delivers high-quality code

This project has the potential to become a **long-term collaboration**, as we continuously develop and maintain WooCommerce websites for our clients.

**When applying, please include:**

1. Examples of complex WooCommerce websites you have built.
2. Examples of custom functionality or plugins you developed.
3. Any experience with configurators, automations, or API integrations.
4. A brief explanation of how you would approach taking over an existing WooCommerce project.

title: XenForo 2.3 AI-Powered RSS Summarizer and Thread Importer Add-on
description:
I need a custom XenForo 2.3 add-on that imports RSS feeds, retrieves each linked article, uses AI to generate a concise summary, and creates a normal XenForo discussion thread.

The website name and subject matter are confidential and should not be mentioned publicly. The site currently uses three RSS feeds and may add more later.

Required workflow

For each new RSS item, the add-on should:

Read the RSS entry and original article URL.
Fetch the linked article page.
Extract the main article text while removing menus, ads, related-content sections, navigation, footers, and other page clutter.
Send the cleaned article text to an AI provider.
Generate a neutral, factual summary of approximately 75–125 words.
Create a standard XenForo discussion thread in the selected forum.
Use the original article headline as the thread title.
Apply the thread prefix assigned to that feed.
Include the AI summary, source attribution, and original article link.
End the post with: “Discuss this story below.”
Prevent duplicate imports using the RSS GUID, canonical URL, or both.

The resulting post should look approximately like this:

[AI-generated summary of approximately 75–125 words.]

Source: [Source name]
[Link to the full article]

Discuss this story below.

Admin CP options

The add-on should allow configuration of:

RSS feed URL
Source name
Destination forum
Thread prefix
Enable or disable each feed
AI provider
AI API key
AI model
Summary length
Editable AI prompt
Feed-check frequency
Maximum articles imported per run
Post immediately or place in moderation
Configurable fallback template

OpenAI support is required. OpenRouter support would be useful if it does not add significant cost or complexity.

Failure handling

If an article cannot be retrieved or summarized, the add-on should:

retry during a later cron run; or
create a link-only post using a configurable fallback template.

It must not create duplicate threads after a failed or repeated attempt.

Logging

A basic Admin CP log should show:

successfully imported
skipped as duplicate
article retrieval failed
AI request failed
awaiting retry
fallback post created
Development requirements
Must be a properly packaged XenForo 2.3 add-on.
Must use XenForo’s standard entities, services, options, permissions, and cron system.
Do not create threads through improvised direct database inserts.
API credentials must be stored appropriately.
The add-on must be suitable for future XenForo updates.
Complete source code must be provided.
I must have the right to continue using and modifying the add-on.
The site name, URL, feed sources, and project details must remain confidential.

examples of XenForo add-ons you have developed
estimated or fixed price
expected completion time

title: Client Collaboration Portal for a Custom Travel Agency
description:
We're a custom travel agency looking for someone to build a client collaboration portal (web applicaiton). Today we plan trips in Travel Joy and collaborate with clients over email, phone, and copy-pasted Google Sheets, which leaves no record of what was agreed and no way for clients to respond to what we propose. We need a portal where each itinerary item — hotel, flight, activity, transfer — carries an approval status: the client either approves it or requests a change with a required comment, we're notified, we make the edit, and a client-visible revision log shows what changed. Behind that we need a CRM for clients and trips, an itinerary builder with typed items and a reusable template library, planner-to-client messaging, notifications, and branded PDF output. Two requirements rule out most platforms: 1. no per-user pricing for clients, we may be planning 100+ trips at a time and a group trip can have 50+ travelers who each need a login to submit their own passport and preference details (i.e., we may have 5,000+ people on the portal at once or), and 2. two-axis record permissions enforced server-side, where everyone on a trip sees the shared itinerary but each traveler sees only their own room and flights, never another traveler's. We haven't picked a platform, but Stacker.ai, Noloco, and Softr have major limitations so more than likely a vibe code/no code platform will not work, and CMS’s like Wordpress also cannot render the capabilities we need. We do have a dedicated enterprise architecture resource on our team that tested this but also does not have the bandwidth to fully architect a platform and implement, so we have a full spec ready below covering the data model, permission matrix, and build phases. 

⭐Please read full spec attachment to learn more about this project

Problem: Our current itinerary tool has no way for clients to give us structured feedback. So when we propose a hotel or a day plan, the response comes back by phone, email, or a copy-pasted spreadsheet. There's no approval status, no record of what changed or why, and no single place either side can look to see where things stand. On a trip with dozens of moving parts, that costs us hours per client and creates real risk of something being missed.

What we need:

A client-facing portal with:

- A CRM: holding client records, trips, travel preferences, and trip history
- An itinerary builder: with typed items including lodging, flights, activities, transfers, restaurants, cruises, rail, car rental — each with its own fields, plus a library of reusable blocks our planners can drop into any trip
- An approval workflow: where each itinerary item moves through In Progress → Pending Approval → Approved, or gets sent back as Change Requested with a mandatory comment explaining why
- A revision log: clients can see, so after we make a change they know exactly what changed
- Comments and messaging: between planners and clients, on individual items and generally
- Notifications: in-app and by email, with the ability to turn email off per event type
- Branded PDF output: of the final itinerary, generated from the portal data

These are non-negotiable and they rule out several popular platforms:

1. **No per-user pricing for clients.** A single group trip can have 50+ travelers, each needing their own login to submit passport details and travel preferences. Per-seat pricing for external users doesn't work for us at any tier.

2. **Two-axis record permissions, enforced server-side.** Everyone on a trip sees the shared day-by-day itinerary. But each traveler sees only *their own* room assignment, flights, and personal data — not the other 49 travelers'. This has to be enforced at the data layer, not by hiding elements in the interface.

Required experience

● 6+ years building and shipping production web applications end to end
● 3+ years specifically on multi-tenant applications where different users see different subsets of the same data — client portals, SaaS platforms, marketplaces, healthcare or legal software, or similar
● Demonstrated experience designing and implementing authorization models, not just authentication. You've built systems where "which records can this user see" was a hard problem, and you can talk about how you solved it
● Experience handling PII in production — passport data, dates of birth, payment references — including encryption at rest, access logging, and least-privilege design

Core technical skills

● Strong backend proficiency in one of: Laravel/PHP, Ruby on Rails, Django/Python, or Node/TypeScript. We're stack-agnostic and will defer to your recommendation, but you should be deeply fluent in whichever you propose rather than learning it on our project
● Relational database design — normalized schema, indexing, migrations. PostgreSQL preferred
● Row-level authorization implemented at the data layer. Postgres RLS, policy objects (Pundit/CanCanCan), Laravel Policies and Gates, Django Guardian, or an equivalent approach you can defend
● Modern frontend: React, Vue, or a server-rendered equivalent (Inertia, Hotwire, Livewire). The interface needs to be genuinely good — planners use it daily and clients judge us by it
● Role-based access control with field-level granularity, not just page-level gating
● Audit logging and change tracking — PaperTrail, django-simple-history, Laravel Auditing, or a custom implementation. We need a client-visible record of what changed on each itinerary item
● REST/webhook integrations: Stripe, JotForm, Kit (ConvertKit)
● Transactional email at production quality — Postmark, SES, or SendGrid, with deliverability configured properly
● Server-side PDF generation from application data with real design fidelity (Puppeteer, Playwright, WeasyPrint, or a rendering service)
● File upload and storage with access control — S3 or equivalent, with signed URLs
● Deployment, environments, and CI/CD. You own staging and production, not just the codebase

Nice to have

● Supabase or similar experience, particularly with Postgres Row-Level Security
● Prior work in travel, hospitality, events, or another domain with group bookings and per-participant data
● Experience with document generation templates at scale
● Background in security review or penetration testing
● Comfort with SOC 2 vendor requirements and compliance documentation

What we're not looking for

● No-code or low-code implementers. We evaluated Stacker, Noloco, and WordPress and decided against them for this build

title: Luxury WordPress Agency Site (Duke & Duchess Reference) + Gravity Forms Vetting Engine
description:
'Job Overview
We are looking for an expert WordPress developer to build a clean, high-end, responsive agency website for Belgravia & Co., an elite domestic staffing agency based in Mayfair.
The front-end design, editorial layout, and visual presentation must directly mirror the aesthetic of Duke & Duchess International (crisp typography, spacious luxury layouts, ivory/black/gold palette).
Technical Stack & Constraints
 Theme Framework: GeneratePress Pro using standard WordPress Gutenberg block containers. (Strictly no heavy page builders like Elementor or Divi to maintain maximum speed).
 Form Engine: Gravity Forms Pro + ACF Pro.
 Security & Performance: Zero-footprint file uploads, lightweight CSS, and full mobile responsiveness.
Project Scope & Core Deliverables
1. Full Front-End Architecture (10+ Marketing Pages)
Build out the complete editorial site layout based on the Duke & Duchess reference structure:
 Home Page: High-end hero section, agency positioning, service overview blocks, and CTA triggers.
 Our Story / About: Heritage, methodology, and agency philosophy.
 Services (4 Dedicated Landing Pages):
 Childcare & Education
 Private Household Staff
 Family Office & Corporate Staff
 Maternity & Newborn Care
 Process Pages: The Approach & The Benchmark (candidate vetting standards).
 Insights / Blog: Clean article index layout and post templates.
 Live Roles / Job Board: Active listings page configured to pass URL parameters into forms.
 Contact Us: Location details and discreet inquiry handling.
2. Gravity Forms Technical Engine
 Candidate Intake Gate ("Join Our Network"): A multi-step AJAX form supporting 6 distinct career tracks (Estate Manager, Butler/Housekeeper, Private Chef, Norland Nanny, Close Protection, Superyacht Crew).
 Scoring & Routing Engine: A 4-stage progress bar with conditional branch logic, a hidden scoring accumulator field, and 3-tier outcome routing (Top Tier, Reserve, Below Threshold).
 Zero-Footprint CV Upload Security: Score-gated CV uploads (PDF/DOC) attached directly to admin notification emails and immediately unlinked/deleted from the server via a ⁠gform_after_submission⁠ PHP hook (zero permanent server footprint).
 Client Intake Engine ("Start a Hire"): Multi-step AJAX lead capture form with branded HTML email routing.
 Live Adverts Infrastructure: Parameter-based hidden fields (⁠?role=x⁠) with cloneable field block templates and a short Loom/PDF guide for internal team use.
Budget & Terms
 Contract Type: Fixed-Price Contract
 Total Fixed Budget: £500 GBP ($650 USD)
 Timeline: 2 to 3 weeks
To Apply:
Please confirm in your response:
1. You accept the £500 GBP / $650 USD fixed-price budget.
2. You agree to build strictly on GeneratePress Pro without Elementor.
3. You have proven experience with Gravity Forms conditional logic, hidden scoring, and PHP hooks (⁠unlink()⁠).
4. Share 2 or 3 examples of luxury, editorial, or agency WordPress sites you have built.

title: Looking for an Experienced Team to Build a Custom Tour Booking System
description:
We are looking for an experienced software company or senior development team to build a custom booking system for our tour company. 

Our website is built on WordPress and code, and the new booking system should integrate seamlessly with it. We are open to the best technical solution. We are NOT looking for an off-the-shelf WordPress booking plugin. We need a scalable, custom-built solution tailored specifically to our business.

Customer Booking Experience
The customer-facing booking system must be available in Polish language and provide a simple, intuitive, and mobile-friendly booking experience.
Customers should be able to:
* Select an available excursion date.
* Choose the number of participants.
* Select their pickup hotel from a predefined list.
* Add optional extras or add-ons.
* Choose a payment method:
  * Cash on arrival.
  * Online payment through a payment gateway (Paysera or similar).
* Receive an automatic confirmation email containing:
  * Booking confirmation.
  * Pickup time based on the selected hotel.
  * A PDF attachment with our booking terms and conditions.
The booking process should be fast and require as few steps as possible.

Agent / Back Office
Our office staff should be able to access the system from any computer using Chrome, Safari, or another browser. A mobile-friendly interface or web application is highly preferred.

Agents (through their profile) should be able to:
Create bookings manually.
Edit bookings.
Change prices.
Apply discounts or surcharges.
Change pickup hotels.
Add additional pickup locations.
Edit customer information.
Change payment methods.
Update booking status.
Add internal notes.

Administrator Panel
The administrator should have advanced management tools.
The system should include features such as:
Filter bookings by date.
Filter by excursion.
Filter by transport or vehicle.
Filter by guide.
Filter by pickup location.
Filter by payment status.
Filter by booking status.
Export bookings to Excel or CSV.
Generate daily operational lists.
Gererate accounting 
Generate passenger lists for guides and drivers.
Generate transport manifests.
Additional operational tools that improve day-to-day management.

What We Expect From You
Please apply only if you have real experience building booking or reservation systems.

Your proposal should include:
Links to similar projects.
Portfolio or live demos.
A brief explanation of your role in those projects.
Your recommended technology stack.
Estimated timeline.
Estimated budget.

IMPORTANT
We are interested only in experienced developers or software companies with proven experience delivering similar projects.

If you do not have relevant experience or cannot provide examples of previous work, please do not apply.

Applications from junior developers or agencies without a relevant portfolio will not receive a response.

We are looking for a long-term technology partner who can continue developing and improving the system after the initial launch.

title: WordPress Expert Needed for Modern SaaS-Style Redesign & MySQL BIN Lookup Integration
description:
Project Scope & Requirements:

Modern SaaS-Style UI/UX Redesign:

Clean, professional layout (similar to Stripe or Marqeta style).

Redesign the Homepage, Pricing/Features, and contact pages from scratch using a lightweight modern WordPress approach (e.g., Elementor or clean Gutenberg blocks).

Custom BIN Lookup Tool (Security & Anti-Scraping Focused):

Input: Users can only enter 6-digit BINs.

Verification: reCAPTCHA integration to prevent bot abuse.

Data Handling & MySQL Query:

The system queries the database (6-digit base + sample 8-11 digit ranges).

If sub-ranges exist, it displays a summary of how many total records and 8-11 digit variants are available.

To showcase data depth, it fetches 6 random sample rows matching the criteria.

Anti-Scraping Output: Instead of raw HTML text, the lookup result must be dynamically generated/rendered as an image with a transparent watermark to prevent data scraping.

"Report Incorrect Result" Feature (Secure Feedback Form):

A clean reporting form for users to flag incorrect BIN data.

Strict Input Validation & Security:

Input must be restricted to strictly 6 digits (no letters, spaces, or special characters allowed on both client-side and server-side to prevent SQL/XSS injections).

Protected by reCAPTCHA to stop automated spam bots.

Database Logging: Validated reports are securely written to a separate moderation table in MySQL for review.

Deliverables:

Fully functional, responsive WordPress website.

Secure PHP/MySQL backend logic for the 6-digit lookup, reCAPTCHA, and dynamic watermarked image generation.

Clean deployment on a staging environment first, then moved to production.

title: WooCommerce Payment Integration + Automated Instance Provisioning (Cross-Server Webhook System)
description:
Overview
We're looking for an experienced PHP/WordPress developer to connect our public-facing WordPress website with our separate application backend so that the entire customer journey, from selecting a package to a live instance being provisioned, is fully automated.

The architecture is already defined. We need someone to build it cleanly, securely, and reliably.

What We Have
A fully built WordPress website (no checkout yet)
A working PHP/MySQL app backend with an existing instance-creation script (you won't need to rewrite it, just trigger it correctly)
A clear architecture diagram and spec we'll share upfront

Scope of Work (3 Fixed-Price Milestones)
Milestone 1 — WooCommerce E-commerce Setup
Install and configure WooCommerce on our existing site, set up our pricing plans as products (recurring subscriptions, monthly/annual), configure WooCommerce Subscriptions, style the checkout to match our existing design, and set up order confirmation emails and customer account pages.

Milestone 2 — Payment Gateway Integration
Integrate a payment gateway (test + live), configure subscription billing with renewals and failed payment handling, support plan upgrades/downgrades, verify webhook signatures, and fully test across card types and edge cases (declined cards, expired cards, mid-cycle plan changes).

Milestone 3 — Webhook + Queue + Automated Provisioning (Core Integration)
This is the main custom piece. On the WordPress side: hook into order/subscription events, HMAC-sign a payload, and POST it securely to our app server. Also build a REST callback endpoint to receive the "instance ready" confirmation and notify the customer.

On the app server side: build a /api/provision endpoint with HMAC verification, a provisioning queue table with status tracking (pending/in_progress/completed/failed), a cron worker that calls our existing provisioning script, retry/failure logic with alerting, and a success callback to WordPress. Must include full idempotency protection against duplicate webhook deliveries.

Deliverable: end-to-end test with a real test payment resulting in an instance being created and the customer notified.

Required Skills
WooCommerce + WooCommerce Subscriptions development
Payment gateway integration (webhooks, subscription lifecycle)
PHP REST API development
HMAC request signing and signature verification
Cron-based job/queue processing
Security-conscious practices — this handles real payments and live infrastructure

title: Laravel Developer to Review Figma Design for Developer-Readiness
description:
Title: Laravel Developer to Review Figma Design for Developer-Readiness

Budget: $100 (Fixed Price)

Description:

I have a website design being completed for me in Figma (delivered via Fiverr). This is a small website — roughly 12-15 pages/screens, with both desktop and mobile (responsive) layouts included in the Figma file. The design files are ready, and before I approve the final delivery, I want an experienced Laravel developer to review them and confirm whether they are fully developer-ready.

What I need you to do:

* Review the Figma design files carefully.
* Confirm whether the design is complete and clear enough to be handed to a developer for a Laravel build — no ambiguity, missing states, or gaps.
* Confirm the mobile/responsive layouts are present and complete for each page, and that breakpoint behavior is clear enough to build.
* Flag anything that is missing or would cause problems during development, for example: missing screens or components, unclear spacing or layout structure, missing hover/active/error states, inconsistent typography or color usage, missing assets/icons, or anything else a developer would need before starting.
* Give me a clear list of any corrections or additions I should request from the designer before I approve the delivery.

How this works:

If you find issues, I will take your feedback back to the Figma designer to fix. Once revised, I'll share the updated file with you to verify the fixes were applied correctly. This may take a couple of rounds (typically 1 initial review + 1–2 verification passes) — the goal of this job is to keep reviewing until the design is confirmed fully developer-ready, so I'm not paying per revision. I want one clear final sign-off from you that the files are ready to build.

What I'm looking for:

* Solid Laravel + front-end development experience (you know what a design needs to contain to be buildable).
* Comfortable reading and evaluating Figma files.

title: WooCommerce Payment Integration + Automated Instance Provisioning (Cross-Server Webhook System)
description:
Overview
We're looking for an experienced PHP/WordPress developer to connect our public-facing WordPress website with our separate application backend so that the entire customer journey, from selecting a package to a live instance being provisioned, is fully automated.

The architecture is already defined. We need someone to build it cleanly, securely, and reliably.

What We Have
A fully built WordPress website (no checkout yet)
A working PHP/MySQL app backend with an existing instance-creation script (you won't need to rewrite it, just trigger it correctly)
A clear architecture diagram and spec we'll share upfront

Scope of Work (3 Fixed-Price Milestones)
Milestone 1 — WooCommerce E-commerce Setup
Install and configure WooCommerce on our existing site, set up our pricing plans as products (recurring subscriptions, monthly/annual), configure WooCommerce Subscriptions, style the checkout to match our existing design, and set up order confirmation emails and customer account pages.

Milestone 2 — Payment Gateway Integration
Integrate a payment gateway (test + live), configure subscription billing with renewals and failed payment handling, support plan upgrades/downgrades, verify webhook signatures, and fully test across card types and edge cases (declined cards, expired cards, mid-cycle plan changes).

Milestone 3 — Webhook + Queue + Automated Provisioning (Core Integration)
This is the main custom piece. On the WordPress side: hook into order/subscription events, HMAC-sign a payload, and POST it securely to our app server. Also build a REST callback endpoint to receive the "instance ready" confirmation and notify the customer.

On the app server side: build a /api/provision endpoint with HMAC verification, a provisioning queue table with status tracking (pending/in_progress/completed/failed), a cron worker that calls our existing provisioning script, retry/failure logic with alerting, and a success callback to WordPress. Must include full idempotency protection against duplicate webhook deliveries.

Deliverable: end-to-end test with a real test payment resulting in an instance being created and the customer notified.

Required Skills
WooCommerce + WooCommerce Subscriptions development
Payment gateway integration (webhooks, subscription lifecycle)
PHP REST API development
HMAC request signing and signature verification
Cron-based job/queue processing
Security-conscious practices — this handles real payments and live infrastructure

title: WordPress Expert Needed for Modern SaaS-Style Redesign & MySQL BIN Lookup Integration
description:
Project Scope & Requirements:

Modern SaaS-Style UI/UX Redesign:

Clean, professional layout (similar to Stripe or Marqeta style).

Redesign the Homepage, Pricing/Features, and contact pages from scratch using a lightweight modern WordPress approach (e.g., Elementor or clean Gutenberg blocks).

Custom BIN Lookup Tool (Security & Anti-Scraping Focused):

Input: Users can only enter 6-digit BINs.

Verification: reCAPTCHA integration to prevent bot abuse.

Data Handling & MySQL Query:

The system queries the database (6-digit base + sample 8-11 digit ranges).

If sub-ranges exist, it displays a summary of how many total records and 8-11 digit variants are available.

To showcase data depth, it fetches 6 random sample rows matching the criteria.

Anti-Scraping Output: Instead of raw HTML text, the lookup result must be dynamically generated/rendered as an image with a transparent watermark to prevent data scraping.

"Report Incorrect Result" Feature (Secure Feedback Form):

A clean reporting form for users to flag incorrect BIN data.

Strict Input Validation & Security:

Input must be restricted to strictly 6 digits (no letters, spaces, or special characters allowed on both client-side and server-side to prevent SQL/XSS injections).

Protected by reCAPTCHA to stop automated spam bots.

Database Logging: Validated reports are securely written to a separate moderation table in MySQL for review.

Deliverables:

Fully functional, responsive WordPress website.

Secure PHP/MySQL backend logic for the 6-digit lookup, reCAPTCHA, and dynamic watermarked image generation.

Clean deployment on a staging environment first, then moved to production.

title: Laravel Developer to Review Figma Design for Developer-Readiness
description:
Title: Laravel Developer to Review Figma Design for Developer-Readiness

Budget: $100 (Fixed Price)

Description:

I have a website design being completed for me in Figma (delivered via Fiverr). This is a small website — roughly 12-15 pages/screens, with both desktop and mobile (responsive) layouts included in the Figma file. The design files are ready, and before I approve the final delivery, I want an experienced Laravel developer to review them and confirm whether they are fully developer-ready.

What I need you to do:

* Review the Figma design files carefully.
* Confirm whether the design is complete and clear enough to be handed to a developer for a Laravel build — no ambiguity, missing states, or gaps.
* Confirm the mobile/responsive layouts are present and complete for each page, and that breakpoint behavior is clear enough to build.
* Flag anything that is missing or would cause problems during development, for example: missing screens or components, unclear spacing or layout structure, missing hover/active/error states, inconsistent typography or color usage, missing assets/icons, or anything else a developer would need before starting.
* Give me a clear list of any corrections or additions I should request from the designer before I approve the delivery.

How this works:

If you find issues, I will take your feedback back to the Figma designer to fix. Once revised, I'll share the updated file with you to verify the fixes were applied correctly. This may take a couple of rounds (typically 1 initial review + 1–2 verification passes) — the goal of this job is to keep reviewing until the design is confirmed fully developer-ready, so I'm not paying per revision. I want one clear final sign-off from you that the files are ready to build.

What I'm looking for:

* Solid Laravel + front-end development experience (you know what a design needs to contain to be buildable).
* Comfortable reading and evaluating Figma files.
* Clear, practical written feedback — a short checklist or bullet-point report is perfect.

This may lead to the full Laravel development project if it goes well.

To apply: Briefly tell me your Laravel experience and confirm you're comfortable reviewing Figma files. Please start your proposal with the word "READY" so I know you've read this. I'll share view access to the design once we connect.
