title: WordPress developer — clean up a bloated Elementor site, then build 3 new pages
description:
run an online guitar school (gypsyandjazz.com). WordPress + Elementor Pro on Cloudways. Courses sell on Thinkific, so there is no WooCommerce to deal with.

The site works, but years of buildup have piled up. A recent audit found five Elementor addon packs running at once, two page builders active (Elementor Pro and WPBakery), three security plugins together, 48 plugins with around 30 pending updates, and 129 pages that are mostly junk. The theme is Educam, and 33 of my 43 posts still render through its post template.

What I want at the end: a site that works properly, loads fast, and is simple for me to update myself.

Phase 1 — cleanup (this job). Get the site to a clean, stable, maintainable state — one addon pack, one page builder, one security plugin, junk removed, everything updated.

My free-lesson posts are my main source of organic traffic. If we move to a lighter theme, they need a proper Elementor post template first — same URLs, same look or better. The theme migration is the last step and only if you're confident; everything else comes first.

All work on a staging copy. I review before anything goes live.

Phase 2 — three new pages (separate job, if phase 1 goes well). Built in Elementor from a mockup I provide, with all the copy and images.

The mockup is a working sketch, not a finished design. I need someone with a good eye to turn it into a polished page, while staying faithful to the structure, the copy and the existing design system. Fast and responsive. Mobile matters — my audience is 50 to 70.

The build must also be SEO-sound: clean markup, fast load, proper heading structure and schema. If you also do SEO or AI-search optimisation, tell me.

Tell me how you would approach Phase 1, your fixed price for it, and roughly how many hours.

Screening questions:

Five Elementor addon packs running at once — what is your view, and how would you work out which widgets are actually in use before removing anything?
Staging or live? What is your rollback plan if something breaks?
Have you built a single-post template in Elementor Pro Theme Builder to move content off a theme's own template?

description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗨𝘀

Website: https://www.calipology.co.uk/

This is an existing WooCommerce store with an established codebase. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with existing projects and can build a clean, reliable solution.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗡𝗲𝗲𝗱
After a customer completes a successful purchase, we’d like to reward them with our own cryptocurrency token.
If the customer has already linked a supported crypto wallet to their account, the website should automatically send a predefined amount of our token to that wallet after the order is completed.
We’re looking for a solution that’s secure, reliable, and easy to maintain.

𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀
• Develop the reward distribution feature for our WooCommerce website.
• Check whether the customer has linked a supported wallet.
• Trigger the reward process after a successful order.
• Send the configured amount of our token to the customer’s linked wallet.
• Make sure each order is rewarded only once.
• Handle failed transactions gracefully and log any errors.
• Test the entire workflow before delivery.

𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
• We’re looking for someone who has experience with:
• WordPress and WooCommerce development
• PHP
• REST APIs
• Blockchain or cryptocurrency integrations
• Working with existing codebases
Experience with smart contracts or blockchain APIs is definitely a plus.

𝗕𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆
To help us find developers who can jump straight into the project, we’d like to ask for one small verification step.
We’ll provide access to our development repository.

title: WordPress developer — clean up a bloated Elementor site, then build 3 new pages
description:
run an online guitar school (gypsyandjazz.com). WordPress + Elementor Pro on Cloudways. Courses sell on Thinkific, so there is no WooCommerce to deal with.

The site works, but years of buildup have piled up. A recent audit found five Elementor addon packs running at once, two page builders active (Elementor Pro and WPBakery), three security plugins together, 48 plugins with around 30 pending updates, and 129 pages that are mostly junk. The theme is Educam, and 33 of my 43 posts still render through its post template.

What I want at the end: a site that works properly, loads fast, and is simple for me to update myself.

Phase 1 — cleanup (this job). Get the site to a clean, stable, maintainable state — one addon pack, one page builder, one security plugin, junk removed, everything updated.

My free-lesson posts are my main source of organic traffic. If we move to a lighter theme, they need a proper Elementor post template first — same URLs, same look or better. The theme migration is the last step and only if you're confident; everything else comes first.

All work on a staging copy. I review before anything goes live.

Phase 2 — three new pages (separate job, if phase 1 goes well). Built in Elementor from a mockup I provide, with all the copy and images.

The mockup is a working sketch, not a finished design. I need someone with a good eye to turn it into a polished page, while staying faithful to the structure, the copy and the existing design system. Fast and responsive. Mobile matters — my audience is 50 to 70.

The build must also be SEO-sound: clean markup, fast load, proper heading structure and schema. If you also do SEO or AI-search optimisation, tell me.

Tell me how you would approach Phase 1, your fixed price for it, and roughly how many hours.

Screening questions:

Five Elementor addon packs running at once — what is your view, and how would you work out which widgets are actually in use before removing anything?
Staging or live? What is your rollback plan if something breaks?
Have you built a single-post template in Elementor Pro Theme Builder to move content off a theme's own template?

description:
Platform: WordPress (Elementor)
Priority: Search function + gated downloads with Oodo integration and pipeline development for Sales team 

1. Project Summary
The client is a superyacht rigging, load-testing, inspection and certification company (www.rsb-rigging.com), built on WordPress with the Elementor page builder. We need three connected pieces of work added to this existing site:
A high functioning site search that also covers a new library of regulatory and manufacturing-guideline documents.
A “gated download” system: visitors give their name, email and a few details before receiving a document.
Automatic syncing of every request into our Odoo CRM as a contact and pipeline opportunity, so sales can see and act on document-driven interest without anyone re-typing data.
A working starter plugin (PHP/JS) implementing all of this is provided with this brief — see Section 7. Your job is to review it, adapt it to our actual Odoo instance and site design, harden it for production, and ship it. Treat it as a strong first draft, not a black box: change anything that doesn't fit our environment.
2. Background
The site (rsb-rigging.com) currently covers Services (Standing Rigging & Spars, Running Rigging, Load Testing, Specialised Services), Projects, Suppliers, News, and Contact, with an existing Privacy Policy page. Search today is the default WordPress search: no relevance ranking, no way to filter by document vs. page, and it won't be able to find items in a new document library by regulation/reference number.
Separately, we currently have no way to gate regulatory documents, class-association guidance, or manufacturer/supplier product and inspection guidelines (e.g. relating to the rigging hardware and cordage brands listed on our Suppliers page) behind a lead form, and no automatic datacapture feature between website activity and our Odoo CRM — downloads and interest are to be used for sales team

title: Senior Full Stack Developer – Build PWR (Phase 1 MVP)
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer – Build PWR (Phase 1 MVP)

About PWR

PWR is a UK-based competition platform with a long-term vision to become one of the UK’s leading competition communities.

This is not a standard WordPress website.

We’re building a scalable software platform that will continue evolving over many years, and we’re looking for a developer who enjoys designing robust systems and thinking beyond the initial build.

This is the first phase of a long-term project with ongoing development opportunities for the right developer.

⸻

Current Status

Significant work has already been completed.

* ✅ Branding completed
* ✅ Business model completed
* ✅ Competition concepts completed
* ✅ Legal documentation (well underway)
* ✅ Technical specification (TS-001 see attached) 
* ✅ Temporary website built using Wix

We are now moving from our temporary Wix website to a fully custom-built competition platform.

⸻

Phase 1 Objective

The objective of Phase 1 is to design, build, test and deploy a fully functional custom competition platform that is ready to replace our existing Wix website.

At the successful completion of Phase 1, the new custom platform should become the primary live website for PWR.

The successful developer will also be responsible for assisting with the migration from Wix to the new platform while maintaining the existing branding and customer experience where practical.

⸻

Phase 1 Deliverables

Customer Features

* Secure user registration and authentication
* Member dashboard
* Competition browsing
* Competition pages
* Competition entry purchasing
* Payment gateway integration (Stripe or suitable alternative)
* Entry numbering system
* Countdown timers
* Competition status management
* Confirmation emails
* Mobile responsive experience

Administration

* Competition Management CMS
* User management
* Winner selection workflow
* Admin dashboard
* Basic reporting and analytics
* Email notification management

Website Migration

* Migration from Wix to the new custom platform
* Preserve branding and website content where appropriate
* Support final deployment of the new platform
* Ensure a smooth transition with minimal downtime

⸻

Future Roadmap

Following a successful Phase 1, future work may include:

* Referral programme
* Winner Hub
* QR integration
* Loyalty programme
* Sponsor portal
* AI features
* Mobile applications
* Advanced reporting dashboards
* Additional competition mechanics
* Business intelligence features

⸻

We’re Looking For Someone Who

✅ Thinks like a software architect

✅ Writes clean, maintainable code

✅ Builds scalable systems

✅ Has experience with memberships and payment platforms

✅ Can clearly explain technical decisions

✅ Is proactive and researches solutions independently

✅ Wants to build a long-term platform rather than simply complete a short-term project

⸻

Ownership & Working Arrangement

We expect all custom work created specifically for PWR, including source code, documentation, designs and other project deliverables, to transfer to and become the property of PWR in accordance with the agreed contract and applicable Upwork Terms of Service.

Wherever practical, development will take place using infrastructure owned by PWR (such as GitHub, cloud hosting, domains and related services), with appropriate developer access granted as required.

Please highlight within your proposal if you expect to use any pre-existing proprietary components or reusable libraries that would remain your intellectual property.

⸻

Please Include In Your Proposal

1. Recommended technology stack and why.
2. Proposed system architecture.
3. Similar platforms you’ve developed.
4. Your suggested approach to building the competition engine.
5. Your estimated Phase 1 timeline.
6. Your estimated Phase 1 cost.

title: WordPress/WooCommerce Developer Needed – Reward Users with Crypto Tokens After Checkout
description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗨𝘀

We are ChainAI Software Company, and we’re looking for an experienced WordPress/WooCommerce developer to help us add a new feature to our ecommerce website.

Website: https://www.calipology.co.uk/

This is an existing WooCommerce store with an established codebase. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with existing projects and can build a clean, reliable solution.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗡𝗲𝗲𝗱
After a customer completes a successful purchase, we’d like to reward them with our own cryptocurrency token.
If the customer has already linked a supported crypto wallet to their account, the website should automatically send a predefined amount of our token to that wallet after the order is completed.
We’re looking for a solution that’s secure, reliable, and easy to maintain.

𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀
• Develop the reward distribution feature for our WooCommerce website.
• Check whether the customer has linked a supported wallet.
• Trigger the reward process after a successful order.
• Send the configured amount of our token to the customer’s linked wallet.
• Make sure each order is rewarded only once.
• Handle failed transactions gracefully and log any errors.
• Test the entire workflow before delivery.

𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
• We’re looking for someone who has experience with:
• WordPress and WooCommerce development
• PHP
• REST APIs
• Blockchain or cryptocurrency integrations
• Working with existing codebases
Experience with smart contracts or blockchain APIs is definitely a plus.

𝗕𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆
To help us find developers who can jump straight into the project, we’d like to ask for one small verification step.
We’ll provide access to our development repository.

https://gitlab.com/chainai/calipology_upgrade_evaluation.git

Please:
1.Clone the repository.
2.Run the website locally.
3.Take a screenshot of the homepage running on your machine.
4.Include the screenshot with your proposal.


𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗱𝗼 𝘄𝗲 𝗮𝘀𝗸 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀?
Over the years, we’ve received quite a few proposals from developers who looked great on paper but later struggled to get the project running locally. That usually leads to unnecessary delays for everyone.
This quick step tells us that you’re comfortable setting up an existing WordPress project and are ready to start working with our codebase. It also helps us filter out generic copy-and-paste proposals and focus on developers who have taken a few minutes to understand the project.
For an experienced WordPress developer, this should only take a few minutes.

𝗡𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝘃𝗲
• Experience with ERC-20, BEP-20, or similar token standards
• Experience sending blockchain transactions
• Wallet integrations such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, or Coinbase Wallet
• Previous WooCommerce plugin development

𝗕𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲𝘁
We’re open to both fixed-price and hourly proposals.
If everything goes well, there’s a good chance of more WordPress and blockchain-related work in the future.

Milestone 1 ($200): Visual pages complete (Home, Keynotes, and Book Hub look correct on desktop and mobile).Milestone 2 ($200): Backend plumbing complete (FluentCRM automations work, test emails hit the primary inbox, and secure file downloads fire correctly).

title: Senior Solo WordPress Developer Needed — Head of WordPress — 10+ Years Experience
description:
We are looking for a senior solo WordPress developer to become the Head of WordPress for our team.

We manage 30+ WordPress websites every month, so this is an ongoing role, not a one-time project. We need someone highly experienced, reliable, independent, and capable of taking full ownership of WordPress development, maintenance, performance, security, and troubleshooting across multiple client websites.

Important: Communication Must Stay on Upwork

Do not contact us outside Upwork.

No LinkedIn.
No email.
No WhatsApp.
No Telegram.
No direct website contact forms.
No other platforms.

All communication must stay strictly inside Upwork.

Any freelancer who contacts us outside Upwork will be rejected immediately.

What We Need

You must have 10+ years of hands-on WordPress development experience and be able to work independently without constant supervision.

You will be responsible for:

* Managing, maintaining, and improving 30+ WordPress websites
* Fixing bugs, layout issues, plugin conflicts, and broken functionality
* Handling theme customization and custom WordPress development
* Working with Elementor, WooCommerce, ACF, custom post types, and popular WordPress plugins
* Improving website speed, Core Web Vitals, security, and technical SEO
* Managing updates, backups, staging environments, migrations, and hosting issues
* Troubleshooting urgent website problems quickly
* Advising our team on best practices for WordPress builds and maintenance
* Creating scalable systems and SOPs for WordPress maintenance

Requirements

You must be:

* A solo freelancer, not an agency
* Experienced with WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL
* Strong with Elementor, WooCommerce, ACF, APIs, hosting, cPanel, Cloudflare
* Comfortable managing many WordPress websites at the same time
* Detail-oriented and able to spot issues before clients do
* Fast with communication and reliable with deadlines
* Able to explain technical issues clearly
* Available for long-term work

Big Advantage If You Have Experience With

* Scandinavian / Nordic business websites
* Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish websites
* Multilingual WordPress sites
* Website speed optimization
* Security hardening
* Malware cleanup
* WP Engine, SiteGround, Cloudways, Kinsta, or similar hosting
* Git, staging workflows, and deployment systems
* Multisite WordPress setups

What We Are Not Looking For

We are not looking for someone who only installs plugins and makes basic Elementor edits.

We need a true senior WordPress expert who can lead WordPress operations, make smart technical decisions, and take responsibility for keeping our clients’ websites stable, secure, fast, and well-maintained.

To Apply

Please answer every question below. Applications that do not answer these questions will be ignored.

1. How many years of WordPress development experience do you have?
2. Are you a solo freelancer or an agency?
3. How many WordPress websites have you managed at the same time?
4. What is your process when a website breaks after a plugin or theme update?
5. What tools do you use for backups, staging, security, and speed optimization?
6. Share the top 3 Scandinavian / Nordic WordPress websites you have built or worked on.
7. For each of those 3 sites, explain exactly what your role was.
8. What is your hourly rate or monthly retainer expectation?
9. Confirm that you will only communicate through Upwork and will not contact us through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, or any other platform.

title: WordPress Maintenance, Hosting & Technical Support Guru
description:
Rocket Launcher is an Australian marketing, digital and technology company supporting a growing portfolio of clients across websites, hosting, domains, email, maintenance, integrations and ongoing technical services.

We are looking for an experienced **WordPress Maintenance, Hosting and Technical Support Specialist** to become a trusted long-term member of our extended team.

This is not simply a website-development role. Your initial focus will be maintaining live client websites, troubleshooting technical issues, managing hosting and domain services, completing website updates and clearly communicating what has happened and how it has been resolved.

title: WordPress Maintenance, Hosting & Technical Support Guru
description:
Rocket Launcher is an Australian marketing, digital and technology company supporting a growing portfolio of clients across websites, hosting, domains, email, maintenance, integrations and ongoing technical services.

We are looking for an experienced **WordPress Maintenance, Hosting and Technical Support Specialist** to become a trusted long-term member of our extended team.

This is not simply a website-development role. Your initial focus will be maintaining live client websites, troubleshooting technical issues, managing hosting and domain services, completing website updates and clearly communicating what has happened and how it has been resolved.

Work will initially be offered on a task-by-task basis. For each task, you will review the requirements and provide an estimated timeframe and cost before commencing. As trust is established, there is strong potential for regular maintenance work, larger technical projects, integrations and full website-development opportunities.

## What We Need Support With

Your work may include:

* WordPress core, plugin and theme updates
* Website maintenance and testing
* Troubleshooting WordPress errors and plugin conflicts
* Fixing broken layouts, forms and website functionality
* Investigating website downtime and critical errors
* Reviewing PHP and server error logs
* Managing website backups and restoration
* Creating and working within staging environments
* Website content and functionality updates
* Website migrations
* Domain registrations, renewals and transfers
* Nameserver and DNS management
* SSL certificate installation and troubleshooting
* cPanel and hosting-account management
* FTP, SFTP, file-manager and database access
* MySQL and phpMyAdmin
* Website performance and security support
* Malware investigation and removal
* Microsoft 365 setup and DNS configuration
* Troubleshooting email-delivery issues
* WHMCS administration and service management
* Coordinating technical issues with hosting and wholesale providers
* Integrating websites with external platforms, applications and business systems

## Integrations

Experience completing integrations across platforms would be highly advantageous.

This may include:

* Website forms and CRM systems
* Email-marketing platforms
* Payment gateways
* Booking systems
* Membership platforms
* Accounting platforms
* WooCommerce
* Microsoft 365
* APIs
* Webhooks
* Zapier
* Make
* WHMCS
* Third-party plugins and software services

You should be able to investigate whether an issue sits within WordPress, a plugin, the hosting environment, DNS, an API or the external platform.

## Systems We Use

Our systems and platforms include:

* Slack for internal team communication
* WHMCS for clients, domains, hosting services, maintenance plans and billing
* Synergy Wholesale for wholesale domain, hosting and related services
* Charla for customer enquiries and support communication
* cPanel and standard hosting-management tools
* WordPress
* Microsoft 365
* Domain and DNS-management platforms
* FTP and SFTP
* phpMyAdmin and MySQL
* Website backup, security and uptime-monitoring tools
* Staging and development environments

You do not need to have used every exact platform. However, you must be technically confident, adaptable and willing to learn our systems.

Experience with WHMCS, Synergy Wholesale or Charla will be highly regarded.

## Essential Skills

You should have practical experience with:

* WordPress maintenance and troubleshooting
* Technical support
* Web hosting
* cPanel or similar control panels
* Domains, DNS and nameservers
* A, CNAME, MX and TXT records
* SPF, DKIM and DMARC
* SSL certificates
* PHP
* MySQL
* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Website backups and restoration
* Website migrations
* Website forms and email delivery
* Microsoft 365 DNS configuration
* Website security and performance
* Investigating live website incidents

You do not need to be an advanced developer in every area, but you must understand enough to diagnose problems, complete appropriate work and recognise when specialist development is required.

## The Person We Are Looking For

We want someone who:

* Takes ownership of technical problems
* Enjoys investigating how and why an issue occurred
* Provides excellent customer service
* Communicates clearly and professionally
* Can explain technical issues in plain English
* Is dependable and responsive
* Provides realistic estimates
* Meets agreed deadlines
* Keeps our team updated
* Identifies risks before they become larger problems
* Thinks beyond the immediate fix
* Is honest when something requires further investigation
* Wants to build a long-term relationship with Rocket Launcher

Communication is one of the most important parts of this role.

A message such as “fixed” or “done” is not enough.

After completing work, we need you to explain:

* What the issue was
* What caused it, where known
* What work you completed
* What was changed
* How you tested the solution
* Whether there is an ongoing risk
* Whether the issue may happen again
* Whether further work is recommended
* What our team should communicate to the client

You must have a good command of written English or be willing to use professional translation and writing tools to ensure your communication is clear and easy to understand.

## How We Work

Slack will be our primary internal communication platform.

When assigned a task, you will generally be expected to:

1. Acknowledge the request.
2. Review the requirements and available access.
3. Ask any necessary questions.
4. Explain your recommended approach.
5. Provide an estimated number of hours, cost and completion timeframe.
6. Wait for approval before starting chargeable work.
7. Provide updates if the work takes longer than expected.
8. Immediately advise us if the scope or estimated cost changes.
9. Test the completed work.
10. Provide a clear written summary of the work completed.

We understand that some technical issues require paid investigation before a final solution can be quoted. In these situations, you should clearly explain the investigation cost and what information it will provide.

We work with live client websites and confidential systems. You will be expected to:

* Take backups before significant changes
* Use staging environments where appropriate
* Avoid high-risk changes directly on live websites
* Test important website functions after changes
* Protect all passwords and client information
* Never install nulled or unlicensed software
* Never subcontract work without approval
* Never contact or solicit Rocket Launcher clients directly
* Never undertake additional chargeable work without approval

## Ongoing Opportunity

There is no guaranteed minimum number of hours at the beginning.

However, Rocket Launcher manages a growing portfolio of websites, domains, hosting accounts and maintenance clients.

A reliable and technically capable person may receive:

* Regular WordPress maintenance work
* Hosting and domain-management tasks
* Technical support requests
* Website-update projects
* Microsoft 365 work
* Website and email migrations
* API and platform-integration projects
* Custom WordPress development
* Full website-development projects
* Greater technical responsibility
* A more consistent ongoing workload

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Rocket Launcher and become the trusted technical specialist our wider team can rely on.

## How to Apply

Begin your application with:

**READY TO LAUNCH**

Please include:

1. A summary of your WordPress maintenance experience.
2. Your experience managing hosting and cPanel accounts.
3. Your experience with domains, DNS and nameservers.
4. Your experience with Microsoft 365.
5. Your experience with WHMCS.
6. Your experience with Synergy Wholesale or similar providers.
7. Your experience completing integrations between websites and external platforms.
8. Examples of APIs, webhooks, CRMs, payment systems or automation tools you have worked with.
9. Your experience troubleshooting hacked, broken or unavailable websites.
10. Your process before completing WordPress updates.
11. How you test your work after completion.
12. How you explain technical issues to non-technical people.
13. Your hourly rate.
14. Your typical response time during working hours.
15. Your availability for urgent website issues.
16. Your location, time zone and usual working hours.
17. Whether you complete the work personally or use subcontractors.
18. Examples of relevant websites or technical projects you have supported.

Please also answer this scenario:

A client contacts us to advise that their WordPress website is unavailable, their website forms are not sending, their Microsoft 365 emails are not being received, and a third-party booking platform is no longer connecting to the website. A staff member recently changed settings within the domain account.

Explain:
* How you would investigate the issue
* What systems and records you would check
* The order in which you would complete your checks
* How you would identify whether the issue relates to the domain, DNS, hosting, WordPress, Microsoft 365 or the third-party platform
* How you would minimise further disruption
* What information you would provide to the Rocket Launcher team
* What preventative recommendations you would make afterwards

Generic applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress website designer and developer to redesign and rebuild the official website of Fabusse China, a professional fashion sourcing, manufacturing, and business consulting platform connecting fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs from the GCC and Arabic markets with trusted factories, manufacturers, suppliers, and creative services in China.

The new website will replace our existing website:

www.fabusse.com

We have prepared a detailed Product Requirements Document (PRD) covering the website vision, target audience, sitemap, service pages, user flows, functional requirements, design direction, content structure, forms, integrations, and expected deliverables. The selected freelancer must carefully review and follow the attached PRD.

This is not a simple template installation. We need a professional, premium, conversion-focused website that presents Fabusse as a trusted international fashion-business partner in China.

Project Objectives

The new website should:

Present Fabusse as a premium and professional China-based fashion sourcing and manufacturing platform.
Generate qualified inquiries from fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.
Encourage visitors to submit sourcing requests, start new projects, and book consultations.
Clearly explain Fabusse’s services, experience, process, and business advantages.
Support both English and Arabic.
Preserve the SEO value and Google rankings of important pages from the current website.
Provide a fast, secure, responsive, and easy-to-manage WordPress system.
Allow the Fabusse team to update pages, services, blog posts, testimonials, and other content without developer assistance.
Important SEO Migration Requirement

Some pages on the existing website are already performing well in Google and must be preserved.

The selected freelancer must complete an SEO-focused website migration, including:

Audit the existing website before development begins.
Identify pages currently receiving organic traffic.
Identify pages currently ranking for useful keywords.
Preserve important existing URLs whenever possible.
Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, image alt text, and internal links where appropriate.
Do not delete, rename, or replace high-performing pages without approval.
Create proper 301 redirects for any URLs that must change.
Avoid broken links and redirect chains.
Preserve the existing domain authority and backlinks.
Create and submit an updated XML sitemap.
Review robots.txt and indexing settings.
Add canonical URLs.
Prevent the staging website from being indexed.
Verify that the final website is indexable after launch.
Connect or maintain Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Monitor crawling and indexing after launch.
Provide an SEO migration report showing:
Retained URLs
Changed URLs
Redirected URLs
Removed URLs
New URLs
Page titles and meta descriptions

No existing SEO page should be deleted or redirected without written approval from Fabusse.

Applicants with real experience in SEO migrations will be strongly preferred.

Platform and Technical Requirements

The website must be developed using WordPress.

The freelancer should recommend the most suitable professional setup, such as:

Custom WordPress theme or professionally customized lightweight theme
Gutenberg, Elementor Pro, Bricks, or another maintainable page-building system
WPML, Polylang, or another reliable multilingual solution
Secure and professionally configured forms
Mobile-first responsive development
Clean and lightweight code
Easy backend content management
Good Core Web Vitals performance
Proper caching and image optimization
Security and backup configuration
Staging environment before launch

Please explain your recommended WordPress setup in your proposal and why you believe it is suitable.

Languages

The website must support:

English
Arabic
Full right-to-left Arabic layout
Language switcher
Correct Arabic typography and spacing
Mobile-friendly Arabic navigation
Independent SEO titles, descriptions, URLs, and content for each language where required

The English and Arabic versions must look equally professional. Arabic must not appear as an automatically mirrored or poorly formatted version of the English website.

Fabusse will provide or approve the final Arabic content.
Main Website Pages
The website will include approximately the following core pages:
1.	Home 
2.	About Fabusse 
3.	Services overview 
4.	Fashion Sourcing 
5.	Garment Manufacturing 
6.	Jewelry Sourcing 
7.	Bags and Shoes 
8.	Cosmetics and Beauty 
9.	Fashion Consulting 
10.	Private Label 
11.	Quality Control 
12.	Logistics 
13.	Book a Consultation 
14.	Start Your Project 
15.	Submit an Inquiry 
16.	Blog / Fashion News 
17.	Contact 
18.	FAQ 
19.	Testimonials / Success Stories 
20.	Privacy Policy 
21.	Terms and Conditions 
22.	Cookie Policy 
23.	Search Results 
24.	Thank You and Confirmation Pages 
25.	404 Page 
The exact sitemap and content structure are explained in the attached PRD.
________________________________________
Core Website Functions
1. Start Your Project Form
The website must include a detailed project request form with fields such as:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone or WhatsApp 
•	Country 
•	Business type 
•	Project category 
•	Project description 
•	Estimated budget 
•	Expected timeline 
•	Reference image or document upload 
After submission:
•	The Fabusse team must receive an email notification. 
•	The inquiry must be saved securely in WordPress. 
•	The visitor must see a confirmation message. 
•	The visitor should be redirected to a dedicated thank-you page. 
•	Spam protection must be implemented. 
________________________________________
2. Product and Sourcing Inquiry Form
The form should collect:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone number 
•	Product category 
•	Product description 
•	Required quantity 
•	Budget 
•	Target market 
•	Reference images 
•	Supporting documents 
•	Additional notes 
The inquiry should be stored in the website backend and emailed to the designated Fabusse team members.
________________________________________
3. Consultation Booking
Integrate Calendly or recommend a better professional booking solution.
The booking system should:
•	Display available consultation times. 
•	Allow visitors to select a date and time. 
•	Collect contact and project information. 
•	Send automatic confirmation emails. 
•	Notify the Fabusse team. 
•	Work correctly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Support the selected website languages where technically possible. 
________________________________________
4. WhatsApp Integration
The website must include:
•	A floating WhatsApp button on all relevant pages. 
•	Pre-filled WhatsApp messages depending on the service page. 
•	Correct mobile and desktop behavior. 
•	Optional tracking of WhatsApp clicks through Google Analytics. 
________________________________________
5. Newsletter Integration
Integrate the website with:
•	Mailchimp, or 
•	MailerLite 
The integration must support:
•	Email validation 
•	Duplicate subscriber handling 
•	Confirmation messages 
•	Consent checkbox where legally required 
•	Proper connection to the mailing list 
________________________________________
6. Blog and Fashion News
The WordPress backend must allow the Fabusse team to:
•	Create and edit articles 
•	Assign categories 
•	Add featured images 
•	Add authors 
•	Schedule posts 
•	Create SEO titles and descriptions 
•	Add internal links 
•	Display related posts 
•	Search blog content 
•	Manage English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
7. Testimonials and Case Studies
The website should support:
•	Client name 
•	Company name 
•	Client photo or logo 
•	Testimonial text 
•	Related service 
•	Case-study images 
•	Business results or project metrics 
•	English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
Design Direction
The website must have a premium, modern, editorial fashion-business identity.
The initial brand direction included in the PRD is:
•	Black: #000000 
•	White 
•	Burgundy: #6D001A 
•	Neutral grey scale 
•	Playfair Display for editorial headlines 
•	Inter for body text and interface elements 
The design should communicate:
•	Fashion expertise 
•	International business credibility 
•	China manufacturing knowledge 
•	Gulf market understanding 
•	Quality and control 
•	Premium consulting 
•	Professional trust 
•	Modern luxury 
The website should not look like:
•	A generic factory template 
•	A cheap sourcing directory 
•	A dropshipping website 
•	A crowded marketplace 
•	A basic corporate template 
•	An overly animated fashion portfolio 
We prefer a clean editorial style with strong typography, professional photography, controlled animations, clear information hierarchy, and visible calls to action.
________________________________________
Design and Development Deliverables
The selected freelancer will be responsible for:
•	Reviewing the full PRD 
•	Auditing the current website 
•	Reviewing existing SEO pages 
•	Final sitemap confirmation 
•	Information architecture 
•	Wireframes where necessary 
•	UI/UX design 
•	Desktop design 
•	Tablet design 
•	Mobile design 
•	Arabic RTL design 
•	WordPress development 
•	Multilingual setup 
•	Form development 
•	File upload functionality 
•	Calendly integration 
•	WhatsApp integration 
•	Newsletter integration 
•	Blog setup 
•	Testimonials setup 
•	Search functionality 
•	On-page SEO implementation 
•	Existing SEO content migration 
•	Redirect implementation 
•	Performance optimization 
•	Security configuration 
•	Backup configuration 
•	Browser testing 
•	Mobile testing 
•	Form testing 
•	Final launch 
•	Post-launch technical support 
•	Website training 
•	Handover documentation 
________________________________________
Required SEO Deliverables
The freelancer must provide:
•	Existing URL audit 
•	Existing page and content inventory 
•	Keyword and ranking-page review 
•	URL mapping document 
•	Redirect mapping document 
•	On-page SEO review 
•	Meta-title and meta-description migration 
•	Heading structure review 
•	Image alt-text migration 
•	Internal-linking review 
•	XML sitemap 
•	Robots.txt review 
•	Canonical implementation 
•	Schema markup where appropriate 
•	Google Search Console verification 
•	Google Analytics or GA4 setup 
•	Broken-link report 
•	Core Web Vitals report 
•	Post-launch indexing check 
Applicants should mention which SEO tools they use, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, or similar professional tools.
________________________________________
Performance Requirements
The website should:
•	Load quickly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Use optimized WebP or AVIF images where appropriate. 
•	Avoid unnecessary plugins. 
•	Use lazy loading correctly. 
•	Have optimized CSS and JavaScript. 
•	Perform well on Google PageSpeed Insights. 
•	Follow Core Web Vitals best practices. 
•	Work correctly on modern browsers. 
•	Remain stable when forms, translations, and integrations are active. 
Applicants should provide realistic performance targets rather than guaranteeing an unrealistic score of 100 on every page.
________________________________________
Security and Data Protection
The website must include:
•	SSL configuration 
•	Secure admin access 
•	Anti-spam protection 
•	Form validation 
•	File-upload security 
•	Scheduled backups 
•	Security plugin or server-level protection 
•	Privacy-policy support 
•	Cookie-consent setup where required 
•	Limited admin permissions 
•	Protection against common WordPress vulnerabilities 
•	Update and maintenance recommendations 
________________________________________
Content Migration
The freelancer must migrate approved content from the existing website.
The work may include:
•	Existing service-page content 
•	Existing blog articles 
•	Existing images 
•	Existing SEO metadata 
•	Existing URLs 
•	Existing internal links 
•	Existing testimonials 
•	Existing contact details 
Content must be reviewed before migration. Duplicate, weak, or outdated content should be identified, but not removed without approval.
________________________________________
Staging and Launch Process
The current website must remain online while the new website is being developed.
Required process:
1.	Create the new website on a secure staging environment. 
2.	Block the staging website from search-engine indexing. 
3.	Complete design, development, and testing on staging. 
4.	Obtain Fabusse approval. 
5.	Back up the existing website. 
6.	Complete the final content and database migration. 
7.	Implement approved redirects. 
8.	Launch the new website on www.fabusse.com. 
9.	Test forms, links, languages, mobile layout, analytics, and indexing. 
10.	Provide post-launch support. 
The live website must not be interrupted unnecessarily during development.
________________________________________
Required Experience
Applicants should have strong experience in:
•	WordPress design and development 
•	UI/UX design 
•	Multilingual WordPress websites 
•	Arabic RTL development 
•	SEO website migrations 
•	Lead-generation websites 
•	Form and file-upload systems 
•	Calendly integration 
•	Mailchimp or MailerLite integration 
•	Website performance optimization 
•	WordPress security 
•	Google Analytics 
•	Google Search Console 
•	Responsive development 
•	Fashion, luxury, sourcing, manufacturing, consulting, or B2B websites 
Experience with fashion, manufacturing, sourcing, China business, or Gulf-region clients is an advantage.

title: Agenda P3 Execution System - Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
AGENDA · ENTRY POINT
The floating start-the-agenda button
Five directions for the always-present glass FAB every employee taps when they clock in. The question underneath each: does it say Agenda, feel HotelHub, and still stand on its own?
Thursday · 6:58 AM · AM Housekeeping
Today's Agenda
4 open

Clock in & collect cart keys
Completed

Stock linen closet — Floor 3
Due 7:30

Inspect 312, 314 (checkout)
Priority

Log any maintenance exceptions
As needed
a





THE FIVE DIRECTIONS
a





The a, resting on the wave BASE
Rounded double-story a in our pill geometry, sitting on the HotelHub equalizer. Letter = Agenda, wave = HotelHub. Calm state.
a





Alive ELITE
Same mark — but the wave pulses and the glass breathes while work is open. Goes still at sign-off. Doctrine you can see.





Wave only — no letter RISK
Pure HotelHub pulse. Beautiful and unmistakably yours — but it says brand, not Agenda. Shown so you feel the gap.

***STOP ***  2 DOCUMENTS ATTACHED ARE SCOPE AND MILESTONES (NON NEG) WORD DOCUMENTS. PLEASE REVIEW FIRST. Thank you 

We are building a tablet-first hotel operations platform used daily by frontline staff, supervisors, and managers. The core of the platform is our Agenda execution system, which governs task completion, accountability, approvals, and audit history.

This role is for Phase 3 of Agenda — a fixed-scope, execution-focused phase.
This is not a rebuild, not an architecture rewrite, and not an open-ended feature expansion.

The system already exists. Your responsibility is to strengthen, unify, and finalize execution behavior so Agenda operates as a reliable, scalable operational engine.

⸻

What Phase 3 Covers

You will work within an explicitly defined scope, including:

Agenda Execution Enhancements
	•	Finalize task execution flow (start → in progress → complete → approve / reject)
	•	Clarify behavior when tasks are rejected (task-level failure with Agenda implications)
	•	Ensure execution state is consistent across Agenda, Approvals, and History
	•	Add task numbering / identifiers to support auditability and drill-downs

Agenda Metadata & Structure
	•	Enforce position-based assignment and visibility (roles are deprecated)
	•	Display position and department consistently across Agenda views
	•	Add Agenda versioning (visible in management and list views)
	•	Improve Agenda list tables to surface meaningful operational context

Review & Approval UX
	•	Add visual status indicators (“bubbles”) per task in approval views
	•	Improve supervisor clarity on what passed, failed, or requires attention
	•	Ensure approval screens are tablet-friendly and readable at a glance

Execution UX (Tablet-First)
	•	Optimize for 10” tablets as primary execution device
	•	Maintain desktop usability; provide guarded mobile (≤768px) behavior
	•	Follow strict device guardrails (execution ≠ admin)
	•	Ensure real-time UI feedback without full page reloads

Governance & Discipline
	•	All work via pull requests
	•	No scope expansion
	•	No backend rewrites
	•	No feature invention outside the approved scope
	•	Any risks or discoveries must be surfaced, not silently fixed

⸻

Explicitly Out of Scope
	•	New modules
	•	Task swapping / sharing between teammates
	•	Major menu redesigns
	•	Permissions system redesign
	•	Video conferencing
	•	Chat expansion
	•	Reporting dashboards
	•	AI features

(Those are planned for later phases and intentionally excluded.)

⸻

Who This Is For

You are a strong fit if you:
	•	Are comfortable working in existing production systems
	•	Respect fixed scope and execution discipline
	•	Think in terms of operations, accountability, and audit trails
	•	Have shipped systems used daily by non-technical staff
	•	Can improve UX without destabilizing logic

This role requires judgment, not just coding.

⸻

Skills Required

Required
	•	PHP (CodeIgniter or similar MVC framework)
	•	MySQL
	•	JavaScript / jQuery
	•	HTML / CSS (responsive, tablet-first UX)
	•	RESTful backend integration
	•	Git (PR-based workflow)

Strongly Preferred
	•	Experience building operational or workflow software
	•	Tablet-first or kiosk-style UX experience
	•	Role/position-based task systems
	•	Audit logs, approvals, or compliance systems
	•	Performance optimization in legacy codebases

⸻

Contract Structure
	•	Fixed-price
	•	Milestone-based
	•	Clearly defined acceptance criteria
	•	No hourly billing

title: Senior Solo WordPress Developer Needed — Head of WordPress — 10+ Years Experience
description:
We are looking for a senior solo WordPress developer to become the Head of WordPress for our team.

We manage 30+ WordPress websites every month, so this is an ongoing role, not a one-time project. We need someone highly experienced, reliable, independent, and capable of taking full ownership of WordPress development, maintenance, performance, security, and troubleshooting across multiple client websites.

Important: Communication Must Stay on Upwork

Do not contact us outside Upwork.

No LinkedIn.
No email.
No WhatsApp.
No Telegram.
No direct website contact forms.
No other platforms.

All communication must stay strictly inside Upwork.

Any freelancer who contacts us outside Upwork will be rejected immediately.

What We Need

You must have 10+ years of hands-on WordPress development experience and be able to work independently without constant supervision.

You will be responsible for:

* Managing, maintaining, and improving 30+ WordPress websites
* Fixing bugs, layout issues, plugin conflicts, and broken functionality
* Handling theme customization and custom WordPress development
* Working with Elementor, WooCommerce, ACF, custom post types, and popular WordPress plugins
* Improving website speed, Core Web Vitals, security, and technical SEO
* Managing updates, backups, staging environments, migrations, and hosting issues
* Troubleshooting urgent website problems quickly
* Advising our team on best practices for WordPress builds and maintenance
* Creating scalable systems and SOPs for WordPress maintenance

Requirements

You must be:

* A solo freelancer, not an agency
* Experienced with WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL
* Strong with Elementor, WooCommerce, ACF, APIs, hosting, cPanel, Cloudflare
* Comfortable managing many WordPress websites at the same time
* Detail-oriented and able to spot issues before clients do
* Fast with communication and reliable with deadlines
* Able to explain technical issues clearly
* Available for long-term work

Big Advantage If You Have Experience With

* Scandinavian / Nordic business websites
* Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, or Finnish websites
* Multilingual WordPress sites
* Website speed optimization
* Security hardening
* Malware cleanup
* WP Engine, SiteGround, Cloudways, Kinsta, or similar hosting
* Git, staging workflows, and deployment systems
* Multisite WordPress setups

What We Are Not Looking For

We are not looking for someone who only installs plugins and makes basic Elementor edits.

We need a true senior WordPress expert who can lead WordPress operations, make smart technical decisions, and take responsibility for keeping our clients’ websites stable, secure, fast, and well-maintained.

To Apply

Please answer every question below. Applications that do not answer these questions will be ignored.

1. How many years of WordPress development experience do you have?
2. Are you a solo freelancer or an agency?
3. How many WordPress websites have you managed at the same time?
4. What is your process when a website breaks after a plugin or theme update?
5. What tools do you use for backups, staging, security, and speed optimization?
6. Share the top 3 Scandinavian / Nordic WordPress websites you have built or worked on.
7. For each of those 3 sites, explain exactly what your role was.
8. What is your hourly rate or monthly retainer expectation?
9. Confirm that you will only communicate through Upwork and will not contact us through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, or any other platform.

title: WordPress Maintenance, Hosting & Technical Support Guru
description:
Rocket Launcher is an Australian marketing, digital and technology company supporting a growing portfolio of clients across websites, hosting, domains, email, maintenance, integrations and ongoing technical services.

We are looking for an experienced **WordPress Maintenance, Hosting and Technical Support Specialist** to become a trusted long-term member of our extended team.

This is not simply a website-development role. Your initial focus will be maintaining live client websites, troubleshooting technical issues, managing hosting and domain services, completing website updates and clearly communicating what has happened and how it has been resolved.

Work will initially be offered on a task-by-task basis. For each task, you will review the requirements and provide an estimated timeframe and cost before commencing. As trust is established, there is strong potential for regular maintenance work, larger technical projects, integrations and full website-development opportunities.

## What We Need Support With

Your work may include:

* WordPress core, plugin and theme updates
* Website maintenance and testing
* Troubleshooting WordPress errors and plugin conflicts
* Fixing broken layouts, forms and website functionality
* Investigating website downtime and critical errors
* Reviewing PHP and server error logs
* Managing website backups and restoration
* Creating and working within staging environments
* Website content and functionality updates
* Website migrations
* Domain registrations, renewals and transfers
* Nameserver and DNS management
* SSL certificate installation and troubleshooting
* cPanel and hosting-account management
* FTP, SFTP, file-manager and database access
* MySQL and phpMyAdmin
* Website performance and security support
* Malware investigation and removal
* Microsoft 365 setup and DNS configuration
* Troubleshooting email-delivery issues
* WHMCS administration and service management
* Coordinating technical issues with hosting and wholesale providers
* Integrating websites with external platforms, applications and business systems

## Integrations

Experience completing integrations across platforms would be highly advantageous.

This may include:

* Website forms and CRM systems
* Email-marketing platforms
* Payment gateways
* Booking systems
* Membership platforms
* Accounting platforms
* WooCommerce
* Microsoft 365
* APIs
* Webhooks
* Zapier
* Make
* WHMCS
* Third-party plugins and software services

You should be able to investigate whether an issue sits within WordPress, a plugin, the hosting environment, DNS, an API or the external platform.

## Systems We Use

Our systems and platforms include:

* Slack for internal team communication
* WHMCS for clients, domains, hosting services, maintenance plans and billing
* Synergy Wholesale for wholesale domain, hosting and related services
* Charla for customer enquiries and support communication
* cPanel and standard hosting-management tools
* WordPress
* Microsoft 365
* Domain and DNS-management platforms
* FTP and SFTP
* phpMyAdmin and MySQL
* Website backup, security and uptime-monitoring tools
* Staging and development environments

You do not need to have used every exact platform. However, you must be technically confident, adaptable and willing to learn our systems.

Experience with WHMCS, Synergy Wholesale or Charla will be highly regarded.

## Essential Skills

You should have practical experience with:

* WordPress maintenance and troubleshooting
* Technical support
* Web hosting
* cPanel or similar control panels
* Domains, DNS and nameservers
* A, CNAME, MX and TXT records
* SPF, DKIM and DMARC
* SSL certificates
* PHP
* MySQL
* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Website backups and restoration
* Website migrations
* Website forms and email delivery
* Microsoft 365 DNS configuration
* Website security and performance
* Investigating live website incidents

You do not need to be an advanced developer in every area, but you must understand enough to diagnose problems, complete appropriate work and recognise when specialist development is required.

## The Person We Are Looking For

We want someone who:

* Takes ownership of technical problems
* Enjoys investigating how and why an issue occurred
* Provides excellent customer service
* Communicates clearly and professionally
* Can explain technical issues in plain English
* Is dependable and responsive
* Provides realistic estimates
* Meets agreed deadlines
* Keeps our team updated
* Identifies risks before they become larger problems
* Thinks beyond the immediate fix
* Is honest when something requires further investigation
* Wants to build a long-term relationship with Rocket Launcher

Communication is one of the most important parts of this role.

A message such as “fixed” or “done” is not enough.

After completing work, we need you to explain:

* What the issue was
* What caused it, where known
* What work you completed
* What was changed
* How you tested the solution
* Whether there is an ongoing risk
* Whether the issue may happen again
* Whether further work is recommended
* What our team should communicate to the client

You must have a good command of written English or be willing to use professional translation and writing tools to ensure your communication is clear and easy to understand.

## How We Work

Slack will be our primary internal communication platform.

When assigned a task, you will generally be expected to:

title: Avada WordPress cleanup, hardening and rebrand
description:
A boutique short-stay accommodation business in Auckland, New Zealand, around 45 properties, needs repair, hardening, and a brand update on its WordPress site. It runs on the Avada theme. This is not a redesign: the layout, navigation, and page structure stay exactly as they are.

The scope of works is already written. Thirty numbered items across five groups.

A. Clean-down. Remove theme demonstration content that was never cleared at launch, being demo post types, taxonomies, posts, and a few leftover pages, and resolve duplicate slider plugin installs.

B. Foundations. Resolve duplicate GA4 tags and transfer property ownership to the client, Search Console, heading structure, page titles and meta descriptions, home page structured data, and three 404 redirects.

C. Security and hygiene. Standard WordPress hardening. The specifics are released on contract.

D. Brand. Logo, favicon set, colour and type tokens, and social share image. All production files are supplied, including a ready-made CSS token file.

E. Cutover readiness. Make a set of hard-coded booking links editable from one place, ahead of a platform migration in September.

Every item states what is wrong, how to verify it, and what done looks like. Replacement text for page titles and meta descriptions is supplied, so that part is data entry rather than copywriting.

What I need in a proposal:

- A price per numbered item, so the client can see what each part costs and remove anything she does not want
- Those grouped into five milestones, one per group
- Your timeline
- Confirmation you can work on staging rather than live

A named WordPress administrator account will be provided. The full scope of works and the brand files are linked in my message to you.

title: Wordpress website
description:

The selected freelancer must carefully review and follow the attached PRD.

This is not a simple template installation. We need a professional, premium, conversion-focused website that presents Fabusse as a trusted international fashion-business partner in China.

Project Objectives

The new website should:

Present Fabusse as a premium and professional China-based fashion sourcing and manufacturing platform.
Generate qualified inquiries from fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.
Encourage visitors to submit sourcing requests, start new projects, and book consultations.
Clearly explain Fabusse’s services, experience, process, and business advantages.
Support both English and Arabic.
Preserve the SEO value and Google rankings of important pages from the current website.
Provide a fast, secure, responsive, and easy-to-manage WordPress system.
Allow the Fabusse team to update pages, services, blog posts, testimonials, and other content without developer assistance.
Important SEO Migration Requirement

The selected freelancer must complete an SEO-focused website migration, including:

Identify pages currently receiving organic traffic.
Identify pages currently ranking for useful keywords.
Preserve important existing URLs whenever possible.
Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, image alt text, and internal links where appropriate.
Do not delete, rename, or replace high-performing pages without approval.
Create proper 301 redirects for any URLs that must change.
Avoid broken links and redirect chains.
Preserve the existing domain authority and backlinks.
Create and submit an updated XML sitemap.
Review robots.txt and indexing settings.
Add canonical URLs.
Prevent the staging website from being indexed.
Verify that the final website is indexable after launch.
Connect or maintain Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Monitor crawling and indexing after launch.
Provide an SEO migration report showing:
Retained URLs
Changed URLs
Redirected URLs
Removed URLs
New URLs
Page titles and meta descriptions

No existing SEO page should be deleted or redirected without written approval from Fabusse.

Applicants with real experience in SEO migrations will be strongly preferred.

Platform and Technical Requirements

The website must be developed using WordPress.

The freelancer should recommend the most suitable professional setup, such as:

Custom WordPress theme or professionally customized lightweight theme
Gutenberg, Elementor Pro, Bricks, or another maintainable page-building system
WPML, Polylang, or another reliable multilingual solution
Secure and professionally configured forms
Mobile-first responsive development
Clean and lightweight code
Easy backend content management
Good Core Web Vitals performance
Proper caching and image optimization
Security and backup configuration
Staging environment before launch

Please explain your recommended WordPress setup in your proposal and why you believe it is suitable.

Languages

The website must support:

English
Arabic
Full right-to-left Arabic layout
Language switcher
Correct Arabic typography and spacing
Mobile-friendly Arabic navigation
Independent SEO titles, descriptions, URLs, and content for each language where required

The English and Arabic versions must look equally professional. Arabic must not appear as an automatically mirrored or poorly formatted version of the English website.

Design Direction
The website must have a premium, modern, editorial fashion-business identity.
The initial brand direction included in the PRD is:
•	Black: #000000 
•	White

•	Internal-linking review

•	Canonical implementation 
•	Schema markup where appropriate 
•	Google Search Console verification 
•	Google Analytics or GA4 setup

•	Core Web Vitals report 
•	Post-launch indexing check 
Applicants should mention which SEO tools they use, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, or similar professional tools.
________________________________________
Performance Requirements
The website should:
•	Load quickly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Use optimized WebP or AVIF images where appropriate. 
•	Avoid unnecessary plugins. 
•	Use lazy loading correctly. 
•	Have optimized CSS and JavaScript. 
•	Perform well on Google PageSpeed Insights. 
•	Follow Core Web Vitals best practices. 
•	Work correctly on modern browsers. 
•	Remain stable when forms, translations, and integrations are active. 
Applicants should provide realistic performance targets rather than guaranteeing an unrealistic score of 100 on every page.
________________________________________
Security and Data Protection
The website must include:
•	SSL configuration 
•	Secure admin access 
•	Anti-spam protection 
•	Form validation 
•	File-upload security 
•	Scheduled backups 
•	Security plugin or server-level protection 
•	Privacy-policy support

## Essential Skills

title: Wordpress website
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress website designer and developer to redesign and rebuild the official website of Fabusse China, a professional fashion sourcing, manufacturing, and business consulting platform connecting fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs from the GCC and Arabic markets with trusted factories, manufacturers, suppliers, and creative services in China.

The new website will replace our existing website:

www.fabusse.com

We have prepared a detailed Product Requirements Document (PRD) covering the website vision, target audience, sitemap, service pages, user flows, functional requirements, design direction, content structure, forms, integrations, and expected deliverables. The selected freelancer must carefully review and follow the attached PRD.

This is not a simple template installation. We need a professional, premium, conversion-focused website that presents Fabusse as a trusted international fashion-business partner in China.

Project Objectives

The new website should:

Present Fabusse as a premium and professional China-based fashion sourcing and manufacturing platform.
Generate qualified inquiries from fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.
Encourage visitors to submit sourcing requests, start new projects, and book consultations.
Clearly explain Fabusse’s services, experience, process, and business advantages.
Support both English and Arabic.
Preserve the SEO value and Google rankings of important pages from the current website.
Provide a fast, secure, responsive, and easy-to-manage WordPress system.
Allow the Fabusse team to update pages, services, blog posts, testimonials, and other content without developer assistance.
Important SEO Migration Requirement

Some pages on the existing website are already performing well in Google and must be preserved.

The selected freelancer must complete an SEO-focused website migration, including:

Audit the existing website before development begins.
Identify pages currently receiving organic traffic.
Identify pages currently ranking for useful keywords.
Preserve important existing URLs whenever possible.
Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, image alt text, and internal links where appropriate.
Do not delete, rename, or replace high-performing pages without approval.
Create proper 301 redirects for any URLs that must change.
Avoid broken links and redirect chains.
Preserve the existing domain authority and backlinks.
Create and submit an updated XML sitemap.
Review robots.txt and indexing settings.
Add canonical URLs.
Prevent the staging website from being indexed.
Verify that the final website is indexable after launch.
Connect or maintain Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Monitor crawling and indexing after launch.
Provide an SEO migration report showing:
Retained URLs
Changed URLs
Redirected URLs
Removed URLs
New URLs
Page titles and meta descriptions

No existing SEO page should be deleted or redirected without written approval from Fabusse.

Applicants with real experience in SEO migrations will be strongly preferred.

Platform and Technical Requirements

The website must be developed using WordPress.

The freelancer should recommend the most suitable professional setup, such as:

Custom WordPress theme or professionally customized lightweight theme
Gutenberg, Elementor Pro, Bricks, or another maintainable page-building system
WPML, Polylang, or another reliable multilingual solution
Secure and professionally configured forms
Mobile-first responsive development
Clean and lightweight code
Easy backend content management
Good Core Web Vitals performance
Proper caching and image optimization
Security and backup configuration
Staging environment before launch

Please explain your recommended WordPress setup in your proposal and why you believe it is suitable.

Languages

The website must support:

English
Arabic
Full right-to-left Arabic layout
Language switcher
Correct Arabic typography and spacing
Mobile-friendly Arabic navigation
Independent SEO titles, descriptions, URLs, and content for each language where required

The English and Arabic versions must look equally professional. Arabic must not appear as an automatically mirrored or poorly formatted version of the English website.

Fabusse will provide or approve the final Arabic content.
Main Website Pages
The website will include approximately the following core pages:
1.	Home 
2.	About Fabusse 
3.	Services overview 
4.	Fashion Sourcing 
5.	Garment Manufacturing 
6.	Jewelry Sourcing 
7.	Bags and Shoes 
8.	Cosmetics and Beauty 
9.	Fashion Consulting

11.	Quality Control 
12.	Logistics

20.	Privacy Policy 
21.	Terms and Conditions 
22.	Cookie Policy 
23.	Search Results 
24.	Thank You and Confirmation Pages 
25.	404 Page 
The exact sitemap and content structure are explained in the attached PRD.
________________________________________
Core Website Functions
1. Start Your Project Form
The website must include a detailed project request form with fields such as:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone or WhatsApp 
•	Country 
•	Business type 
•	Project category 
•	Project description 
•	Estimated budget 
•	Expected timeline 
•	Reference image or document upload 
After submission:
•	The Fabusse team must receive an email notification. 
•	The inquiry must be saved securely in WordPress. 
•	The visitor must see a confirmation message. 
•	The visitor should be redirected to a dedicated thank-you page. 
•	Spam protection must be implemented. 
________________________________________
2. Product and Sourcing Inquiry Form
The form should collect:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone number 
•	Product category 
•	Product description 
•	Required quantity 
•	Budget 
•	Target market 
•	Reference images 
•	Supporting documents 
•	Additional notes

________________________________________

The booking system should:
•	Display available consultation times. 
•	Allow visitors to select a date and time. 
•	Collect contact and project information. 
•	Send automatic confirmation emails. 
•	Notify the Fabusse team. 
•	Work correctly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Support the selected website languages where technically possible. 
________________________________________
4. WhatsApp Integration
The website must include:
•	A floating WhatsApp button on all relevant pages.

•	MailerLite

•	Email validation 
•	Duplicate subscriber handling

The WordPress backend must allow the Fabusse team to:
•	Create and edit articles 
•	Assign categories 
•	Add featured images 
•	Add authors 
•	Schedule posts 
•	Create SEO titles and descriptions 
•	Add internal links 
•	Display related posts

The website should support:
•	Client name

•	Related service 
•	Case-study images 
•	Business results or project metrics 
•	English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
Design Direction
The website must have a premium, modern, editorial fashion-business identity.
The initial brand direction included in the PRD is:
•	Black: #000000 
•	White 
•	Burgundy: #6D001A

The website should not look like:

•	A dropshipping website 
•	A crowded marketplace 
•	A basic corporate template 
•	An overly animated fashion portfolio 
We prefer a clean editorial style with strong typography, professional photography, controlled animations, clear information hierarchy, and visible calls to action.
________________________________________
Design and Development Deliverables
The selected freelancer will be responsible for:
•	Reviewing the full PRD 
•	Auditing the current website 
•	Reviewing existing SEO pages 
•	Final sitemap confirmation

•	Keyword and ranking-page review 
•	URL mapping document 
•	Redirect mapping document 
•	On-page SEO review 
•	Meta-title and meta-description migration 
•	Heading structure review 
•	Image alt-text migration 
•	Internal-linking review 
•	XML sitemap 
•	Robots.txt review 
•	Canonical implementation 
•	Schema markup where appropriate 
•	Google Search Console verification 
•	Google Analytics or GA4 setup 
•	Broken-link report 
•	Core Web Vitals report 
•	Post-launch indexing check 
Applicants should mention which SEO tools they use, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, or similar professional tools.
________________________________________
Performance Requirements
The website should:
•	Load quickly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Use optimized WebP or AVIF images where appropriate. 
•	Avoid unnecessary plugins. 
•	Use lazy loading correctly. 
•	Have optimized CSS and JavaScript. 
•	Perform well on Google PageSpeed Insights. 
•	Follow Core Web Vitals best practices. 
•	Work correctly on modern browsers. 
•	Remain stable when forms, translations, and integrations are active. 
Applicants should provide realistic performance targets rather than guaranteeing an unrealistic score of 100 on every page.
________________________________________
Security and Data Protection
The website must include:
•	SSL configuration 
•	Secure admin access 
•	Anti-spam protection 
•	Form validation 
•	File-upload security 
•	Scheduled backups 
•	Security plugin or server-level protection 
•	Privacy-policy support 
•	Cookie-consent setup where required

•	Protection against common WordPress vulnerabilities 
•	Update and maintenance recommendations

Content Migration
The freelancer must migrate approved content from the existing website.
The work may include:
•	Existing service-page content 
•	Existing blog articles 
•	Existing images 
•	Existing SEO metadata 
•	Existing URLs 
•	Existing internal links 
•	Existing testimonials 
•	Existing contact details 
Content must be reviewed before migration. Duplicate, weak, or outdated content should be identified, but not removed without approval.
________________________________________
Staging and Launch Process
The current website must remain online while the new website is being developed.
Required process:
1.	Create the new website on a secure staging environment. 
2.	Block the staging website from search-engine indexing. 
3.	Complete design, development, and testing on staging. 
4.	Obtain Fabusse approval. 
5.	Back up the existing website. 
6.	Complete the final content and database migration. 
7.	Implement approved redirects. 
8.	Launch the new website on www.fabusse.com.

10.	Provide post-launch support.

## The Person We Are Looking For

We want someone who:

* Takes ownership of technical problems
* Enjoys investigating how and why an issue occurred
* Provides excellent customer service
* Communicates clearly and professionally
* Can explain technical issues in plain English
* Is dependable and responsive
* Provides realistic estimates
* Meets agreed deadlines
* Keeps our team updated
* Identifies risks before they become larger problems
* Thinks beyond the immediate fix
* Is honest when something requires further investigation
* Wants to build a long-term relationship with Rocket Launcher

Communication is one of the most important parts of this role.

A message such as “fixed” or “done” is not enough.

After completing work, we need you to explain:

* What the issue was
* What caused it, where known
* What work you completed
* What was changed
* How you tested the solution
* Whether there is an ongoing risk
* Whether the issue may happen again
* Whether further work is recommended
* What our team should communicate to the client

You must have a good command of written English or be willing to use professional translation and writing tools to ensure your communication is clear and easy to understand.

## How We Work

Slack will be our primary internal communication platform.

When assigned a task, you will generally be expected to:

1. Acknowledge the request.
2. Review the requirements and available access.
3. Ask any necessary questions.
4. Explain your recommended approach.
5. Provide an estimated number of hours, cost and completion timeframe.
6. Wait for approval before starting chargeable work.
7. Provide updates if the work takes longer than expected.
8. Immediately advise us if the scope or estimated cost changes.
9. Test the completed work.
10. Provide a clear written summary of the work completed.

We understand that some technical issues require paid investigation before a final solution can be quoted. In these situations, you should clearly explain the investigation cost and what information it will provide.

We work with live client websites and confidential systems. You will be expected to:

* Take backups before significant changes
* Use staging environments where appropriate
* Avoid high-risk changes directly on live websites
* Test important website functions after changes
* Protect all passwords and client information
* Never install nulled or unlicensed software
* Never subcontract work without approval
* Never contact or solicit Rocket Launcher clients directly
* Never undertake additional chargeable work without approval

## Ongoing Opportunity

There is no guaranteed minimum number of hours at the beginning.

However, Rocket Launcher manages a growing portfolio of websites, domains, hosting accounts and maintenance clients.

A reliable and technically capable person may receive:

* Regular WordPress maintenance work
* Hosting and domain-management tasks
* Technical support requests
* Website-update projects
* Microsoft 365 work
* Website and email migrations
* API and platform-integration projects
* Custom WordPress development
* Full website-development projects
* Greater technical responsibility
* A more consistent ongoing workload

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Rocket Launcher and become the trusted technical specialist our wider team can rely on.

## How to Apply

Begin your application with:

**READY TO LAUNCH**

Please include:

1. A summary of your WordPress maintenance experience.
2. Your experience managing hosting and cPanel accounts.
3. Your experience with domains, DNS and nameservers.
4. Your experience with Microsoft 365.
5. Your experience with WHMCS.
6. Your experience with Synergy Wholesale or similar providers.
7. Your experience completing integrations between websites and external platforms.
8. Examples of APIs, webhooks, CRMs, payment systems or automation tools you have worked with.
9. Your experience troubleshooting hacked, broken or unavailable websites.
10. Your process before completing WordPress updates.
11. How you test your work after completion.
12. How you explain technical issues to non-technical people.
13. Your hourly rate.
14. Your typical response time during working hours.
15. Your availability for urgent website issues.
16. Your location, time zone and usual working hours.
17. Whether you complete the work personally or use subcontractors.
18. Examples of relevant websites or technical projects you have supported.

Please also answer this scenario:

A client contacts us to advise that their WordPress website is unavailable, their website forms are not sending, their Microsoft 365 emails are not being received, and a third-party booking platform is no longer connecting to the website. A staff member recently changed settings within the domain account.

Explain:
* How you would investigate the issue
* What systems and records you would check
* The order in which you would complete your checks
* How you would identify whether the issue relates to the domain, DNS, hosting, WordPress, Microsoft 365 or the third-party platform
* How you would minimise further disruption

Generic applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

description:

Project Objectives

The new website should:

Present Fabusse as a premium and professional China-based fashion sourcing and manufacturing platform.
Generate qualified inquiries from fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.
Encourage visitors to submit sourcing requests, start new projects, and book consultations.
Clearly explain Fabusse’s services, experience, process, and business advantages.
Support both English and Arabic.
Preserve the SEO value and Google rankings of important pages from the current website.
Provide a fast, secure, responsive, and easy-to-manage WordPress system.
Allow the Fabusse team to update pages, services, blog posts, testimonials, and other content without developer assistance.
