title: Wordpress website
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress website designer and developer to redesign and rebuild the official website of Fabusse China, a professional fashion sourcing, manufacturing, and business consulting platform connecting fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs from the GCC and Arabic markets with trusted factories, manufacturers, suppliers, and creative services in China.

The new website will replace our existing website:

www.fabusse.com

We have prepared a detailed Product Requirements Document (PRD) covering the website vision, target audience, sitemap, service pages, user flows, functional requirements, design direction, content structure, forms, integrations, and expected deliverables. The selected freelancer must carefully review and follow the attached PRD.

This is not a simple template installation. We need a professional, premium, conversion-focused website that presents Fabusse as a trusted international fashion-business partner in China.

Project Objectives

The new website should:

Present Fabusse as a premium and professional China-based fashion sourcing and manufacturing platform.
Generate qualified inquiries from fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.
Encourage visitors to submit sourcing requests, start new projects, and book consultations.
Clearly explain Fabusse’s services, experience, process, and business advantages.
Support both English and Arabic.
Preserve the SEO value and Google rankings of important pages from the current website.
Provide a fast, secure, responsive, and easy-to-manage WordPress system.
Allow the Fabusse team to update pages, services, blog posts, testimonials, and other content without developer assistance.
Important SEO Migration Requirement

Some pages on the existing website are already performing well in Google and must be preserved.

The selected freelancer must complete an SEO-focused website migration, including:

Audit the existing website before development begins.
Identify pages currently receiving organic traffic.
Identify pages currently ranking for useful keywords.
Preserve important existing URLs whenever possible.
Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, image alt text, and internal links where appropriate.
Do not delete, rename, or replace high-performing pages without approval.
Create proper 301 redirects for any URLs that must change.
Avoid broken links and redirect chains.
Preserve the existing domain authority and backlinks.
Create and submit an updated XML sitemap.
Review robots.txt and indexing settings.
Add canonical URLs.
Prevent the staging website from being indexed.
Verify that the final website is indexable after launch.
Connect or maintain Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Monitor crawling and indexing after launch.
Provide an SEO migration report showing:
Retained URLs
Changed URLs
Redirected URLs
Removed URLs
New URLs
Page titles and meta descriptions

No existing SEO page should be deleted or redirected without written approval from Fabusse.

Applicants with real experience in SEO migrations will be strongly preferred.

Platform and Technical Requirements

The website must be developed using WordPress.

The freelancer should recommend the most suitable professional setup, such as:

Custom WordPress theme or professionally customized lightweight theme
Gutenberg, Elementor Pro, Bricks, or another maintainable page-building system
WPML, Polylang, or another reliable multilingual solution
Secure and professionally configured forms
Mobile-first responsive development
Clean and lightweight code
Easy backend content management
Good Core Web Vitals performance
Proper caching and image optimization
Security and backup configuration
Staging environment before launch

Please explain your recommended WordPress setup in your proposal and why you believe it is suitable.

Languages

The website must support:

English
Arabic
Full right-to-left Arabic layout
Language switcher
Correct Arabic typography and spacing
Mobile-friendly Arabic navigation
Independent SEO titles, descriptions, URLs, and content for each language where required

The English and Arabic versions must look equally professional. Arabic must not appear as an automatically mirrored or poorly formatted version of the English website.

Fabusse will provide or approve the final Arabic content.
Main Website Pages
The website will include approximately the following core pages:
1.	Home 
2.	About Fabusse 
3.	Services overview 
4.	Fashion Sourcing 
5.	Garment Manufacturing 
6.	Jewelry Sourcing 
7.	Bags and Shoes 
8.	Cosmetics and Beauty 
9.	Fashion Consulting 
10.	Private Label 
11.	Quality Control 
12.	Logistics 
13.	Book a Consultation 
14.	Start Your Project 
15.	Submit an Inquiry 
16.	Blog / Fashion News 
17.	Contact 
18.	FAQ 
19.	Testimonials / Success Stories 
20.	Privacy Policy 
21.	Terms and Conditions 
22.	Cookie Policy 
23.	Search Results 
24.	Thank You and Confirmation Pages 
25.	404 Page 
The exact sitemap and content structure are explained in the attached PRD.
________________________________________
Core Website Functions
1. Start Your Project Form
The website must include a detailed project request form with fields such as:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone or WhatsApp 
•	Country 
•	Business type 
•	Project category 
•	Project description 
•	Estimated budget 
•	Expected timeline 
•	Reference image or document upload 
After submission:
•	The Fabusse team must receive an email notification. 
•	The inquiry must be saved securely in WordPress. 
•	The visitor must see a confirmation message. 
•	The visitor should be redirected to a dedicated thank-you page. 
•	Spam protection must be implemented. 
________________________________________
2. Product and Sourcing Inquiry Form
The form should collect:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone number 
•	Product category 
•	Product description 
•	Required quantity 
•	Budget 
•	Target market 
•	Reference images 
•	Supporting documents 
•	Additional notes 
The inquiry should be stored in the website backend and emailed to the designated Fabusse team members.
________________________________________
3. Consultation Booking
Integrate Calendly or recommend a better professional booking solution.
The booking system should:
•	Display available consultation times. 
•	Allow visitors to select a date and time. 
•	Collect contact and project information. 
•	Send automatic confirmation emails. 
•	Notify the Fabusse team. 
•	Work correctly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Support the selected website languages where technically possible. 
________________________________________
4. WhatsApp Integration
The website must include:
•	A floating WhatsApp button on all relevant pages. 
•	Pre-filled WhatsApp messages depending on the service page. 
•	Correct mobile and desktop behavior. 
•	Optional tracking of WhatsApp clicks through Google Analytics. 
________________________________________
5. Newsletter Integration
Integrate the website with:
•	Mailchimp, or 
•	MailerLite 
The integration must support:
•	Email validation 
•	Duplicate subscriber handling 
•	Confirmation messages 
•	Consent checkbox where legally required 
•	Proper connection to the mailing list 
________________________________________
6. Blog and Fashion News
The WordPress backend must allow the Fabusse team to:
•	Create and edit articles 
•	Assign categories 
•	Add featured images 
•	Add authors 
•	Schedule posts 
•	Create SEO titles and descriptions 
•	Add internal links 
•	Display related posts 
•	Search blog content 
•	Manage English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
7. Testimonials and Case Studies
The website should support:
•	Client name 
•	Company name 
•	Client photo or logo 
•	Testimonial text 
•	Related service 
•	Case-study images 
•	Business results or project metrics 
•	English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
Design Direction
The website must have a premium, modern, editorial fashion-business identity.
The initial brand direction included in the PRD is:
•	Black: #000000 
•	White 
•	Burgundy: #6D001A 
•	Neutral grey scale 
•	Playfair Display for editorial headlines 
•	Inter for body text and interface elements 
The design should communicate:
•	Fashion expertise 
•	International business credibility 
•	China manufacturing knowledge 
•	Gulf market understanding 
•	Quality and control 
•	Premium consulting 
•	Professional trust 
•	Modern luxury 
The website should not look like:
•	A generic factory template 
•	A cheap sourcing directory 
•	A dropshipping website 
•	A crowded marketplace 
•	A basic corporate template 
•	An overly animated fashion portfolio 
We prefer a clean editorial style with strong typography, professional photography, controlled animations, clear information hierarchy, and visible calls to action.
________________________________________
Design and Development Deliverables
The selected freelancer will be responsible for:
•	Reviewing the full PRD 
•	Auditing the current website 
•	Reviewing existing SEO pages 
•	Final sitemap confirmation 
•	Information architecture 
•	Wireframes where necessary 
•	UI/UX design 
•	Desktop design 
•	Tablet design 
•	Mobile design 
•	Arabic RTL design 
•	WordPress development 
•	Multilingual setup 
•	Form development 
•	File upload functionality 
•	Calendly integration 
•	WhatsApp integration 
•	Newsletter integration 
•	Blog setup 
•	Testimonials setup 
•	Search functionality 
•	On-page SEO implementation 
•	Existing SEO content migration 
•	Redirect implementation 
•	Performance optimization 
•	Security configuration 
•	Backup configuration 
•	Browser testing 
•	Mobile testing 
•	Form testing 
•	Final launch 
•	Post-launch technical support 
•	Website training 
•	Handover documentation 
________________________________________
Required SEO Deliverables
The freelancer must provide:
•	Existing URL audit 
•	Existing page and content inventory 
•	Keyword and ranking-page review 
•	URL mapping document 
•	Redirect mapping document 
•	On-page SEO review 
•	Meta-title and meta-description migration 
•	Heading structure review 
•	Image alt-text migration 
•	Internal-linking review 
•	XML sitemap 
•	Robots.txt review 
•	Canonical implementation 
•	Schema markup where appropriate 
•	Google Search Console verification 
•	Google Analytics or GA4 setup 
•	Broken-link report 
•	Core Web Vitals report 
•	Post-launch indexing check 
Applicants should mention which SEO tools they use, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, or similar professional tools.
________________________________________
Performance Requirements
The website should:
•	Load quickly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Use optimized WebP or AVIF images where appropriate. 
•	Avoid unnecessary plugins. 
•	Use lazy loading correctly. 
•	Have optimized CSS and JavaScript. 
•	Perform well on Google PageSpeed Insights. 
•	Follow Core Web Vitals best practices. 
•	Work correctly on modern browsers. 
•	Remain stable when forms, translations, and integrations are active. 
Applicants should provide realistic performance targets rather than guaranteeing an unrealistic score of 100 on every page.
________________________________________
Security and Data Protection
The website must include:
•	SSL configuration 
•	Secure admin access 
•	Anti-spam protection 
•	Form validation 
•	File-upload security 
•	Scheduled backups 
•	Security plugin or server-level protection 
•	Privacy-policy support 
•	Cookie-consent setup where required 
•	Limited admin permissions 
•	Protection against common WordPress vulnerabilities 
•	Update and maintenance recommendations 
________________________________________
Content Migration
The freelancer must migrate approved content from the existing website.
The work may include:
•	Existing service-page content 
•	Existing blog articles 
•	Existing images 
•	Existing SEO metadata 
•	Existing URLs 
•	Existing internal links 
•	Existing testimonials 
•	Existing contact details 
Content must be reviewed before migration. Duplicate, weak, or outdated content should be identified, but not removed without approval.
________________________________________
Staging and Launch Process
The current website must remain online while the new website is being developed.
Required process:
1.	Create the new website on a secure staging environment. 
2.	Block the staging website from search-engine indexing. 
3.	Complete design, development, and testing on staging. 
4.	Obtain Fabusse approval. 
5.	Back up the existing website. 
6.	Complete the final content and database migration. 
7.	Implement approved redirects. 
8.	Launch the new website on www.fabusse.com. 
9.	Test forms, links, languages, mobile layout, analytics, and indexing. 
10.	Provide post-launch support. 
The live website must not be interrupted unnecessarily during development.
________________________________________
Required Experience
Applicants should have strong experience in:
•	WordPress design and development 
•	UI/UX design 
•	Multilingual WordPress websites 
•	Arabic RTL development 
•	SEO website migrations 
•	Lead-generation websites 
•	Form and file-upload systems 
•	Calendly integration 
•	Mailchimp or MailerLite integration 
•	Website performance optimization 
•	WordPress security 
•	Google Analytics 
•	Google Search Console 
•	Responsive development 
•	Fashion, luxury, sourcing, manufacturing, consulting, or B2B websites 
Experience with fashion, manufacturing, sourcing, China business, or Gulf-region clients is an advantage.

title: Wordpress website
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress website designer and developer to redesign and rebuild the official website of Fabusse China, a professional fashion sourcing, manufacturing, and business consulting platform connecting fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs from the GCC and Arabic markets with trusted factories, manufacturers, suppliers, and creative services in China.

The new website will replace our existing website:

www.fabusse.com

We have prepared a detailed Product Requirements Document (PRD) covering the website vision, target audience, sitemap, service pages, user flows, functional requirements, design direction, content structure, forms, integrations, and expected deliverables. The selected freelancer must carefully review and follow the attached PRD.

This is not a simple template installation. We need a professional, premium, conversion-focused website that presents Fabusse as a trusted international fashion-business partner in China.

Project Objectives

The new website should:

Present Fabusse as a premium and professional China-based fashion sourcing and manufacturing platform.
Generate qualified inquiries from fashion brands, designers, retailers, boutique owners, investors, and entrepreneurs.
Encourage visitors to submit sourcing requests, start new projects, and book consultations.
Clearly explain Fabusse’s services, experience, process, and business advantages.
Support both English and Arabic.
Preserve the SEO value and Google rankings of important pages from the current website.
Provide a fast, secure, responsive, and easy-to-manage WordPress system.
Allow the Fabusse team to update pages, services, blog posts, testimonials, and other content without developer assistance.
Important SEO Migration Requirement

Some pages on the existing website are already performing well in Google and must be preserved.

The selected freelancer must complete an SEO-focused website migration, including:

Audit the existing website before development begins.
Identify pages currently receiving organic traffic.
Identify pages currently ranking for useful keywords.
Preserve important existing URLs whenever possible.
Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, image alt text, and internal links where appropriate.
Do not delete, rename, or replace high-performing pages without approval.
Create proper 301 redirects for any URLs that must change.
Avoid broken links and redirect chains.
Preserve the existing domain authority and backlinks.
Create and submit an updated XML sitemap.
Review robots.txt and indexing settings.
Add canonical URLs.
Prevent the staging website from being indexed.
Verify that the final website is indexable after launch.
Connect or maintain Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Monitor crawling and indexing after launch.
Provide an SEO migration report showing:
Retained URLs
Changed URLs
Redirected URLs
Removed URLs
New URLs
Page titles and meta descriptions

No existing SEO page should be deleted or redirected without written approval from Fabusse.

Applicants with real experience in SEO migrations will be strongly preferred.

Platform and Technical Requirements

The website must be developed using WordPress.

The freelancer should recommend the most suitable professional setup, such as:

Custom WordPress theme or professionally customized lightweight theme
Gutenberg, Elementor Pro, Bricks, or another maintainable page-building system
WPML, Polylang, or another reliable multilingual solution
Secure and professionally configured forms
Mobile-first responsive development
Clean and lightweight code
Easy backend content management
Good Core Web Vitals performance
Proper caching and image optimization
Security and backup configuration
Staging environment before launch

Please explain your recommended WordPress setup in your proposal and why you believe it is suitable.

Languages

The website must support:

English
Arabic
Full right-to-left Arabic layout
Language switcher
Correct Arabic typography and spacing
Mobile-friendly Arabic navigation
Independent SEO titles, descriptions, URLs, and content for each language where required

The English and Arabic versions must look equally professional. Arabic must not appear as an automatically mirrored or poorly formatted version of the English website.

Fabusse will provide or approve the final Arabic content.
Main Website Pages
The website will include approximately the following core pages:
1.	Home 
2.	About Fabusse 
3.	Services overview 
4.	Fashion Sourcing 
5.	Garment Manufacturing 
6.	Jewelry Sourcing 
7.	Bags and Shoes 
8.	Cosmetics and Beauty 
9.	Fashion Consulting 
10.	Private Label 
11.	Quality Control 
12.	Logistics 
13.	Book a Consultation 
14.	Start Your Project 
15.	Submit an Inquiry 
16.	Blog / Fashion News 
17.	Contact 
18.	FAQ 
19.	Testimonials / Success Stories 
20.	Privacy Policy 
21.	Terms and Conditions 
22.	Cookie Policy 
23.	Search Results 
24.	Thank You and Confirmation Pages 
25.	404 Page 
The exact sitemap and content structure are explained in the attached PRD.
________________________________________
Core Website Functions
1. Start Your Project Form
The website must include a detailed project request form with fields such as:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone or WhatsApp 
•	Country 
•	Business type 
•	Project category 
•	Project description 
•	Estimated budget 
•	Expected timeline 
•	Reference image or document upload 
After submission:
•	The Fabusse team must receive an email notification. 
•	The inquiry must be saved securely in WordPress. 
•	The visitor must see a confirmation message. 
•	The visitor should be redirected to a dedicated thank-you page. 
•	Spam protection must be implemented. 
________________________________________
2. Product and Sourcing Inquiry Form
The form should collect:
•	Full name 
•	Company name 
•	Email 
•	Phone number 
•	Product category 
•	Product description 
•	Required quantity 
•	Budget 
•	Target market 
•	Reference images 
•	Supporting documents 
•	Additional notes 
The inquiry should be stored in the website backend and emailed to the designated Fabusse team members.
________________________________________
3. Consultation Booking
Integrate Calendly or recommend a better professional booking solution.
The booking system should:
•	Display available consultation times. 
•	Allow visitors to select a date and time. 
•	Collect contact and project information. 
•	Send automatic confirmation emails. 
•	Notify the Fabusse team. 
•	Work correctly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Support the selected website languages where technically possible. 
________________________________________
4. WhatsApp Integration
The website must include:
•	A floating WhatsApp button on all relevant pages. 
•	Pre-filled WhatsApp messages depending on the service page. 
•	Correct mobile and desktop behavior. 
•	Optional tracking of WhatsApp clicks through Google Analytics. 
________________________________________
5. Newsletter Integration
Integrate the website with:
•	Mailchimp, or 
•	MailerLite 
The integration must support:
•	Email validation 
•	Duplicate subscriber handling 
•	Confirmation messages 
•	Consent checkbox where legally required 
•	Proper connection to the mailing list 
________________________________________
6. Blog and Fashion News
The WordPress backend must allow the Fabusse team to:
•	Create and edit articles 
•	Assign categories 
•	Add featured images 
•	Add authors 
•	Schedule posts 
•	Create SEO titles and descriptions 
•	Add internal links 
•	Display related posts 
•	Search blog content 
•	Manage English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
7. Testimonials and Case Studies
The website should support:
•	Client name 
•	Company name 
•	Client photo or logo 
•	Testimonial text 
•	Related service 
•	Case-study images 
•	Business results or project metrics 
•	English and Arabic versions 
________________________________________
Design Direction
The website must have a premium, modern, editorial fashion-business identity.
The initial brand direction included in the PRD is:
•	Black: #000000 
•	White 
•	Burgundy: #6D001A 
•	Neutral grey scale 
•	Playfair Display for editorial headlines 
•	Inter for body text and interface elements 
The design should communicate:
•	Fashion expertise 
•	International business credibility 
•	China manufacturing knowledge 
•	Gulf market understanding 
•	Quality and control 
•	Premium consulting 
•	Professional trust 
•	Modern luxury 
The website should not look like:
•	A generic factory template 
•	A cheap sourcing directory 
•	A dropshipping website 
•	A crowded marketplace 
•	A basic corporate template 
•	An overly animated fashion portfolio 
We prefer a clean editorial style with strong typography, professional photography, controlled animations, clear information hierarchy, and visible calls to action.
________________________________________
Design and Development Deliverables
The selected freelancer will be responsible for:
•	Reviewing the full PRD 
•	Auditing the current website 
•	Reviewing existing SEO pages 
•	Final sitemap confirmation 
•	Information architecture 
•	Wireframes where necessary 
•	UI/UX design 
•	Desktop design 
•	Tablet design 
•	Mobile design 
•	Arabic RTL design 
•	WordPress development 
•	Multilingual setup 
•	Form development 
•	File upload functionality 
•	Calendly integration 
•	WhatsApp integration 
•	Newsletter integration 
•	Blog setup 
•	Testimonials setup 
•	Search functionality 
•	On-page SEO implementation 
•	Existing SEO content migration 
•	Redirect implementation 
•	Performance optimization 
•	Security configuration 
•	Backup configuration 
•	Browser testing 
•	Mobile testing 
•	Form testing 
•	Final launch 
•	Post-launch technical support 
•	Website training 
•	Handover documentation 
________________________________________
Required SEO Deliverables
The freelancer must provide:
•	Existing URL audit 
•	Existing page and content inventory 
•	Keyword and ranking-page review 
•	URL mapping document 
•	Redirect mapping document 
•	On-page SEO review 
•	Meta-title and meta-description migration 
•	Heading structure review 
•	Image alt-text migration 
•	Internal-linking review 
•	XML sitemap 
•	Robots.txt review 
•	Canonical implementation 
•	Schema markup where appropriate 
•	Google Search Console verification 
•	Google Analytics or GA4 setup 
•	Broken-link report 
•	Core Web Vitals report 
•	Post-launch indexing check 
Applicants should mention which SEO tools they use, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, or similar professional tools.
________________________________________
Performance Requirements
The website should:
•	Load quickly on mobile and desktop. 
•	Use optimized WebP or AVIF images where appropriate. 
•	Avoid unnecessary plugins. 
•	Use lazy loading correctly. 
•	Have optimized CSS and JavaScript. 
•	Perform well on Google PageSpeed Insights. 
•	Follow Core Web Vitals best practices. 
•	Work correctly on modern browsers. 
•	Remain stable when forms, translations, and integrations are active. 
Applicants should provide realistic performance targets rather than guaranteeing an unrealistic score of 100 on every page.
________________________________________
Security and Data Protection
The website must include:
•	SSL configuration 
•	Secure admin access 
•	Anti-spam protection 
•	Form validation 
•	File-upload security 
•	Scheduled backups 
•	Security plugin or server-level protection 
•	Privacy-policy support 
•	Cookie-consent setup where required 
•	Limited admin permissions 
•	Protection against common WordPress vulnerabilities 
•	Update and maintenance recommendations 
________________________________________
Content Migration
The freelancer must migrate approved content from the existing website.
The work may include:
•	Existing service-page content 
•	Existing blog articles 
•	Existing images 
•	Existing SEO metadata 
•	Existing URLs 
•	Existing internal links 
•	Existing testimonials 
•	Existing contact details 
Content must be reviewed before migration. Duplicate, weak, or outdated content should be identified, but not removed without approval.
________________________________________
Staging and Launch Process
The current website must remain online while the new website is being developed.
Required process:
1.	Create the new website on a secure staging environment. 
2.	Block the staging website from search-engine indexing. 
3.	Complete design, development, and testing on staging. 
4.	Obtain Fabusse approval. 
5.	Back up the existing website. 
6.	Complete the final content and database migration. 
7.	Implement approved redirects. 
8.	Launch the new website on www.fabusse.com. 
9.	Test forms, links, languages, mobile layout, analytics, and indexing. 
10.	Provide post-launch support. 
The live website must not be interrupted unnecessarily during development.
________________________________________
Required Experience
Applicants should have strong experience in:
•	WordPress design and development 
•	UI/UX design 
•	Multilingual WordPress websites 
•	Arabic RTL development 
•	SEO website migrations 
•	Lead-generation websites 
•	Form and file-upload systems 
•	Calendly integration 
•	Mailchimp or MailerLite integration 
•	Website performance optimization 
•	WordPress security 
•	Google Analytics 
•	Google Search Console 
•	Responsive development 
•	Fashion, luxury, sourcing, manufacturing, consulting, or B2B websites 
Experience with fashion, manufacturing, sourcing, China business, or Gulf-region clients is an advantage.

Development and Launch: (Premium Bespoke Ecosystem)

Targeting the premium budget tier, this approach delivers a fully bespoke build offering maximum scalability, top-tier SEO architectural dominance, a highly polished UI, and backend tools tailored specifically to automate your internal operational processes.

To-do

- Develop a custom headless front-end (e.g., Nuxt.js/React) for maximum loading speed and SEO dominance.
- Build advanced, multi-layered product filtering (by condition, battery health, storage, colour).
- Implement deep technical SEO setup, including advanced schema markups and Core Web Vitals optimisation.

title: Websitw developer needed
description:
**Problem Statement**
Sayed Mahmood is launching a digital storefront for a newly established chain of Tech Shops in the Republic of Ireland. Expanding from face-to-face retail and local broadcast sales, the business needs a highly scalable e-commerce platform to sell large volumes of brand-new and refurbished smartphones (primarily Apple and Samsung). The primary challenge is successfully entering a highly competitive online market. Therefore, the platform must prioritise top-tier Google SEO architecture to compete with established platforms like refurbed.ie and thephonebox.ie. Furthermore, to build credibility in the refurbished tech market, the client requires a trustworthy environment that incorporates third-party IMEI verification to assure customers of product legitimacy.

**Solution**
Design and develop a custom, highly SEO-optimised e-commerce website tailored specifically for high-volume tech retail. The solution will establish a clean, professional visual identity and provide a frictionless user journey from product discovery to checkout.
- **Core E-commerce Flow:** Intuitive product browsing with detailed item configurations (condition/grade, colour, screen size, storage capacity, return policy), seamless basket management, and secure checkout.
- **Advanced Filtering:** A robust filtering system allowing users to sort and narrow down products by brand, price, storage, colour, and condition.
- **IMEI Verification Integration:** Implementation of a third-party API checker to allow customers to verify the IMEI of refurbished devices prior to purchase, significantly enhancing buyer trust.
- **Payment and Shipping:** Integration of a reliable payment gateway supporting standard Card payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, alongside selectable shipping options (Express and Standard delivery via DHL).
- **Simplified Inventory Management:** An easy-to-use CMS allowing the client to manually update, add, or remove inventory and product models seamlessly, mapping to their existing Excel-based workflows.
- **SEO and Digital Branding:** Foundational digital brand creation (UI style guide, typography, colour schemes) based on the client's provided logo, coupled with deep technical and on-page SEO optimisation to ensure a strong search engine presence from day one.

Development and Launch: (Premium Bespoke Ecosystem)

Targeting the premium budget tier, this approach delivers a fully bespoke build offering maximum scalability, top-tier SEO architectural dominance, a highly polished UI, and backend tools tailored specifically to automate your internal operational processes.

To-do

- Develop a custom headless front-end (e.g., Nuxt.js/React) for maximum loading speed and SEO dominance.
- Build advanced, multi-layered product filtering (by condition, battery health, storage, colour).
- Implement deep technical SEO setup, including advanced schema markups and Core Web Vitals optimisation.
- Integrate the third-party IMEI verification API natively directly into the product pages.
- Configure custom shipping rules engine for Express and Standard DHL delivery calculations.
- Implement automated abandoned cart recovery email sequences to boost conversions.
- Set up advanced caching layers via CDN for lightning-fast image and asset delivery.
- Implement Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager with custom event tracking for precise e-commerce conversion data.
- Build a bespoke CMS logic tailored specifically to your Excel-based inventory workflow, allowing for automated bulk CSV imports and exports of stock.
- Implement advanced UI micro-animations and page transitions for a premium, high-end brand feel.
- Develop built-in review generation features and seamless Trustpilot integration to build immediate trust for refurbished goods.
- Implement AI-powered "Frequently Bought Together" and alternative product recommendations on product pages.
- Prepare the database architecture for future multi-currency and multi-language scaling.
- Develop custom, branded PDF invoice generation sent automatically upon purchase.
- Conduct extensive load testing and server scaling preparation to handle massive traffic spikes during major marketing campaigns or Black Friday.

Deliverables

- Premium Bespoke E-commerce Ecosystem
- Custom Inventory Automation CMS
- Review and Trust-building Integration
- Production Deployment

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js + WordPress) — Long-Term, Individual Only
description:
## Read This First

We're hiring **one dedicated developer** to join our small team long-term. Before anything else, two things that decide whether you should keep reading:

**1. Individual applicants only.** We will not consider agencies, teams, studios, collectives, or subcontracting arrangements — no exceptions. If you represent multiple developers or plan to distribute the work, this role is not a fit.

**2. This is a role for someone who communicates by default.** We are a small, fast-moving team, and our work is directed in real time across many client accounts. That only works when the person we rely on keeps us in the loop *without being asked*. If you do excellent work but tend to go quiet until someone comes looking for you, this is not the right seat — and we'd rather both know that now. More on exactly what we mean below, because it matters more than any line on the tech stack.

---

## Compensation & Trial Structure

- **Initial 4-week paid trial** at **$120 USD/week** (full-time).
- Month 2: On successful completion of Month 1, transition to a *$800 USD/month** full-time salary.
- Month 3: On successful completion of Month 2, transition to a **$1,000 USD/month** full-time salary.
- Long-term: Continued opportunity for growth in compensation, tied to performance, reliability, and ownership.

## Interview Process

- **Two short, paid sample tasks** — one frontend, one backend.
- Provide a short video explaining why you are a good fit for the row
- Sample dev tasks: Each paid a flat **$5 USD**.
- The tasks are intentionally small. Completing them is required to move forward.

---

## The Role

This is a **long-term, full-time** role supporting large, complex web projects on modern architecture. Projects unfold over **months, not weeks**, and our frontend approach varies by project:

- **Headless frontends** (Next.js)
- **WordPress-based frontends** (custom themes, block-based builds)

You'll own real, evolving work on live client sites. We care as much about *how you think, communicate, and handle ambiguity* as we do about what you can build.

Open to international candidates, with two firm requirements:

- **Consistent, predictable availability overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours** (see "How We Work Together").
- **Fluent written and spoken English.**

---

## 🤝 How We Work Together (The Part That Matters Most)

Most of what makes someone succeed here isn't technical. It's whether working with you feels like having a real teammate in the room. Three things are **hard requirements**, not nice-to-haves:

### 1. You communicate proactively — I never have to chase you

You tell me where things stand before I have to ask. Picked something up, hit a wall, made a judgment call, changed an approach — I hear it from you, in real time, not after I go digging. Same-day responsiveness during EST hours is the baseline. If being expected to over-communicate reads as micromanagement to you, we will frustrate each other; the people who thrive here *like* keeping their team looped in.

### 2. Your work speaks for itself

Tasks move at a steady, visible cadence. Statuses and ETAs are accurate and current. I can see progress in the work itself without auditing your hours — because good communication and clean, legible delivery make that unnecessary. If a deadline is going to slip, **I know before the deadline, not after**, and I know why.

### 3. You own your own accountability — especially the misses

This is the one most people never say out loud, so we will: if you start late, lose hours, or fall behind on something you committed to, **you bring it to me first.** I should never be the one who notices and has to ask. Owning a shortfall before it's discovered is worth more to me than a perfect week, and it's the single clearest signal of someone I can build a long-term relationship with. Flag risk and uncertainty early; going silent when something's wrong is the one thing that doesn't work here.

### On availability — be concrete

"Flexible" and "full-time" don't tell me what I need. Pick a **consistent daily window** that overlaps U.S. Eastern business hours and hold to it day to day, so I always know when I can reach you. When that window needs to change, I hear about it **in advance**. Predictability matters more than any specific clock — a reliable four-hour daily overlap beats "around whenever."

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack (Required Experience)

**Frontend**
- Next.js (primary headless frontend)
- WordPress-based frontends (custom themes, block-based builds)
- GraphQL
- Apollo Client
- TailwindCSS
- SCSS / CSS Modules

**Backend**
- WordPress CMS (headless and traditional use)
- Typesense (search)

**Hosting**
- Vercel (frontend hosting)
- Linode (backend infrastructure)

**Integrations**
- Yoast SEO
- Cloudflare Turnstile
- Brevo
- Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager, Search Console

---

## 🚨 What This Role Actually Requires

This is **not** a task-only execution role. We're looking for someone who:

- Works comfortably across **both** modern JS frontends and WordPress frontends
- Takes real ownership of long-running, evolving projects
- Communicates clearly and proactively in English, in real time
- Is available for same-day collaboration during EST hours, on a schedule I can count on
- Keeps task status and ETAs accurate and current on their own
- Surfaces risk, delay, and uncertainty early — and owns it when something slips
- Thinks in systems, not just tickets

If you prefer tightly scoped, short-term work, or want to stay inside a single framework, this won't be a good fit.

---

## ✅ Ideal Candidate

You:

- Are an **individual contributor** (not part of an agency or team)
- Have real experience with **headless CMS architectures and WordPress frontends**
- Can deploy, maintain, and debug sites on **Vercel and Linode**
- Understand search-first experiences and how **Typesense** fits into both architectures
- Write clean, maintainable code and can clearly explain your decisions
- Treat communication, reliability, and shared accountability as core parts of the job — not overhead
- Are comfortable working closely with a U.S.-based team, in real time, across time zones

---

## 📅 Scope & Structure

- Long-term role — not a short-term contract
- Large, complex, multi-month projects
- Frontend approach varies by project (Next.js vs. WordPress)
- The initial period is genuine mutual evaluation
- Strong performers grow in **responsibility, autonomy, and compensation**

---

## 🧠 How to Apply (No Boilerplate, Please)

Send a short note answering:

1. **Tell me about a project that took longer than expected.** How — and *when* — did you communicate the changes and manage expectations?
2. **Tell me about a time you fell behind, started late, or missed hours you'd committed to.** How did you handle it, and how did your manager or client find out?
3. **What does ownership mean to you** on a long-running project?
4. **Describe your experience with Next.js and WordPress frontends** (links welcome).
5. **What is your consistent daily availability overlap with U.S. Eastern Time**, and how do you handle it when that window needs to change?
6. **Are you comfortable providing same-day responses during EST working hours?**

We read every answer. The notes that stand out are specific, honest, and show us how you keep the people you work with in the loop.

- **IMEI Verification Integration:** Implementation of a third-party API checker to allow customers to verify the IMEI of refurbished devices prior to purchase, significantly enhancing buyer trust.
- **Payment and Shipping:** Integration of a reliable payment gateway supporting standard Card payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, alongside selectable shipping options (Express and Standard delivery via DHL).

- Production Deployment

title: Websitw developer needed
description:
**Problem Statement**
Sayed Mahmood is launching a digital storefront for a newly established chain of Tech Shops in the Republic of Ireland. Expanding from face-to-face retail and local broadcast sales, the business needs a highly scalable e-commerce platform to sell large volumes of brand-new and refurbished smartphones (primarily Apple and Samsung). The primary challenge is successfully entering a highly competitive online market. Therefore, the platform must prioritise top-tier Google SEO architecture to compete with established platforms like refurbed.ie and thephonebox.ie. Furthermore, to build credibility in the refurbished tech market, the client requires a trustworthy environment that incorporates third-party IMEI verification to assure customers of product legitimacy.

**Solution**
Design and develop a custom, highly SEO-optimised e-commerce website tailored specifically for high-volume tech retail. The solution will establish a clean, professional visual identity and provide a frictionless user journey from product discovery to checkout.
- **Core E-commerce Flow:** Intuitive product browsing with detailed item configurations (condition/grade, colour, screen size, storage capacity, return policy), seamless basket management, and secure checkout.
- **Advanced Filtering:** A robust filtering system allowing users to sort and narrow down products by brand, price, storage, colour, and condition.
- **IMEI Verification Integration:** Implementation of a third-party API checker to allow customers to verify the IMEI of refurbished devices prior to purchase, significantly enhancing buyer trust.
- **Payment and Shipping:** Integration of a reliable payment gateway supporting standard Card payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, alongside selectable shipping options (Express and Standard delivery via DHL).
- **Simplified Inventory Management:** An easy-to-use CMS allowing the client to manually update, add, or remove inventory and product models seamlessly, mapping to their existing Excel-based workflows.
- **SEO and Digital Branding:** Foundational digital brand creation (UI style guide, typography, colour schemes) based on the client's provided logo, coupled with deep technical and on-page SEO optimisation to ensure a strong search engine presence from day one.

Development and Launch: (Premium Bespoke Ecosystem)

Targeting the premium budget tier, this approach delivers a fully bespoke build offering maximum scalability, top-tier SEO architectural dominance, a highly polished UI, and backend tools tailored specifically to automate your internal operational processes.

- Develop a custom headless front-end (e.g., Nuxt.js/React) for maximum loading speed and SEO dominance.
- Build advanced, multi-layered product filtering (by condition, battery health, storage, colour).
- Implement deep technical SEO setup, including advanced schema markups and Core Web Vitals optimisation.
- Integrate the third-party IMEI verification API natively directly into the product pages.
- Configure custom shipping rules engine for Express and Standard DHL delivery calculations.
- Implement automated abandoned cart recovery email sequences to boost conversions.
- Set up advanced caching layers via CDN for lightning-fast image and asset delivery.
- Implement Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager with custom event tracking for precise e-commerce conversion data.
- Build a bespoke CMS logic tailored specifically to your Excel-based inventory workflow, allowing for automated bulk CSV imports and exports of stock.
- Implement advanced UI micro-animations and page transitions for a premium, high-end brand feel.
- Develop built-in review generation features and seamless Trustpilot integration to build immediate trust for refurbished goods.
- Implement AI-powered "Frequently Bought Together" and alternative product recommendations on product pages.
- Prepare the database architecture for future multi-currency and multi-language scaling.
- Develop custom, branded PDF invoice generation sent automatically upon purchase.
- Conduct extensive load testing and server scaling preparation to handle massive traffic spikes during major marketing campaigns or Black Friday.

Deliverables

- Premium Bespoke E-commerce Ecosystem
- Custom Inventory Automation CMS
- Review and Trust-building Integration
- Production Deployment

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js + WordPress) — Long-Term, Individual Only
description:
## Read This First

We're hiring **one dedicated developer** to join our small team long-term. Before anything else, two things that decide whether you should keep reading:

**1. Individual applicants only.** We will not consider agencies, teams, studios, collectives, or subcontracting arrangements — no exceptions. If you represent multiple developers or plan to distribute the work, this role is not a fit.

**2. This is a role for someone who communicates by default.** We are a small, fast-moving team, and our work is directed in real time across many client accounts. That only works when the person we rely on keeps us in the loop *without being asked*. If you do excellent work but tend to go quiet until someone comes looking for you, this is not the right seat — and we'd rather both know that now. More on exactly what we mean below, because it matters more than any line on the tech stack.

---

## Compensation & Trial Structure

- **Initial 4-week paid trial** at **$120 USD/week** (full-time).
- Month 2: On successful completion of Month 1, transition to a *$800 USD/month** full-time salary.
- Month 3: On successful completion of Month 2, transition to a **$1,000 USD/month** full-time salary.
- Long-term: Continued opportunity for growth in compensation, tied to performance, reliability, and ownership.

## Interview Process

- **Two short, paid sample tasks** — one frontend, one backend.
- Provide a short video explaining why you are a good fit for the row
- Sample dev tasks: Each paid a flat **$5 USD**.
- The tasks are intentionally small. Completing them is required to move forward.

---

## The Role

This is a **long-term, full-time** role supporting large, complex web projects on modern architecture. Projects unfold over **months, not weeks**, and our frontend approach varies by project:

- **Headless frontends** (Next.js)
- **WordPress-based frontends** (custom themes, block-based builds)

You'll own real, evolving work on live client sites. We care as much about *how you think, communicate, and handle ambiguity* as we do about what you can build.

Open to international candidates, with two firm requirements:

- **Consistent, predictable availability overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours** (see "How We Work Together").
- **Fluent written and spoken English.**

---

## 🤝 How We Work Together (The Part That Matters Most)

Most of what makes someone succeed here isn't technical. It's whether working with you feels like having a real teammate in the room. Three things are **hard requirements**, not nice-to-haves:

### 1. You communicate proactively — I never have to chase you

You tell me where things stand before I have to ask. Picked something up, hit a wall, made a judgment call, changed an approach — I hear it from you, in real time, not after I go digging. Same-day responsiveness during EST hours is the baseline. If being expected to over-communicate reads as micromanagement to you, we will frustrate each other; the people who thrive here *like* keeping their team looped in.

### 2. Your work speaks for itself

Tasks move at a steady, visible cadence. Statuses and ETAs are accurate and current. I can see progress in the work itself without auditing your hours — because good communication and clean, legible delivery make that unnecessary. If a deadline is going to slip, **I know before the deadline, not after**, and I know why.

### 3. You own your own accountability — especially the misses

This is the one most people never say out loud, so we will: if you start late, lose hours, or fall behind on something you committed to, **you bring it to me first.** I should never be the one who notices and has to ask. Owning a shortfall before it's discovered is worth more to me than a perfect week, and it's the single clearest signal of someone I can build a long-term relationship with. Flag risk and uncertainty early; going silent when something's wrong is the one thing that doesn't work here.

### On availability — be concrete

"Flexible" and "full-time" don't tell me what I need. Pick a **consistent daily window** that overlaps U.S. Eastern business hours and hold to it day to day, so I always know when I can reach you. When that window needs to change, I hear about it **in advance**. Predictability matters more than any specific clock — a reliable four-hour daily overlap beats "around whenever."

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack (Required Experience)

**Frontend**
- Next.js (primary headless frontend)
- WordPress-based frontends (custom themes, block-based builds)
- GraphQL
- Apollo Client
- TailwindCSS
- SCSS / CSS Modules

**Backend**
- WordPress CMS (headless and traditional use)
- Typesense (search)

**Hosting**
- Vercel (frontend hosting)
- Linode (backend infrastructure)

**Integrations**
- Yoast SEO
- Cloudflare Turnstile
- Brevo
- Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager, Search Console

---

## 🚨 What This Role Actually Requires

This is **not** a task-only execution role. We're looking for someone who:

- Works comfortably across **both** modern JS frontends and WordPress frontends
- Takes real ownership of long-running, evolving projects
- Communicates clearly and proactively in English, in real time
- Is available for same-day collaboration during EST hours, on a schedule I can count on
- Keeps task status and ETAs accurate and current on their own
- Surfaces risk, delay, and uncertainty early — and owns it when something slips
- Thinks in systems, not just tickets

If you prefer tightly scoped, short-term work, or want to stay inside a single framework, this won't be a good fit.

---

## ✅ Ideal Candidate

You:

- Are an **individual contributor** (not part of an agency or team)
- Have real experience with **headless CMS architectures and WordPress frontends**
- Can deploy, maintain, and debug sites on **Vercel and Linode**
- Understand search-first experiences and how **Typesense** fits into both architectures
- Write clean, maintainable code and can clearly explain your decisions
- Treat communication, reliability, and shared accountability as core parts of the job — not overhead
- Are comfortable working closely with a U.S.-based team, in real time, across time zones

---

## 📅 Scope & Structure

- Long-term role — not a short-term contract
- Large, complex, multi-month projects
- Frontend approach varies by project (Next.js vs. WordPress)
- The initial period is genuine mutual evaluation
- Strong performers grow in **responsibility, autonomy, and compensation**

---

## 🧠 How to Apply (No Boilerplate, Please)

Send a short note answering:

1. **Tell me about a project that took longer than expected.** How — and *when* — did you communicate the changes and manage expectations?
2. **Tell me about a time you fell behind, started late, or missed hours you'd committed to.** How did you handle it, and how did your manager or client find out?
3. **What does ownership mean to you** on a long-running project?
4. **Describe your experience with Next.js and WordPress frontends** (links welcome).
5. **What is your consistent daily availability overlap with U.S. Eastern Time**, and how do you handle it when that window needs to change?
6. **Are you comfortable providing same-day responses during EST working hours?**

We read every answer. The notes that stand out are specific, honest, and show us how you keep the people you work with in the loop.

I can see progress in the work itself without auditing your hours — because good communication and clean, legible delivery make that unnecessary. If a deadline is going to slip, **I know before the deadline, not after**, and I know why.

### 3. You own your own accountability — especially the misses

This is the one most people never say out loud, so we will: if you start late, lose hours, or fall behind on something you committed to, **you bring it to me first.** I should never be the one who notices and has to ask. Owning a shortfall before it's discovered is worth more to me than a perfect week, and it's the single clearest signal of someone I can build a long-term relationship with. Flag risk and uncertainty early; going silent when something's wrong is the one thing that doesn't work here.

### On availability — be concrete

"Flexible" and "full-time" don't tell me what I need. Pick a **consistent daily window** that overlaps U.S. Eastern business hours and hold to it day to day, so I always know when I can reach you. When that window needs to change, I hear about it **in advance**. Predictability matters more than any specific clock — a reliable four-hour daily overlap beats "around whenever."

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack (Required Experience)

**Frontend**
- Next.js (primary headless frontend)
- WordPress-based frontends (custom themes, block-based builds)
- GraphQL
- Apollo Client
- TailwindCSS
- SCSS / CSS Modules

**Backend**
- WordPress CMS (headless and traditional use)
- Typesense (search)

**Hosting**
- Vercel (frontend hosting)
- Linode (backend infrastructure)

**Integrations**
- Yoast SEO
- Cloudflare Turnstile
- Brevo
- Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager, Search Console

---

## 🚨 What This Role Actually Requires

This is **not** a task-only execution role. We're looking for someone who:

- Works comfortably across **both** modern JS frontends and WordPress frontends
- Takes real ownership of long-running, evolving projects
- Communicates clearly and proactively in English, in real time
- Is available for same-day collaboration during EST hours, on a schedule I can count on
- Keeps task status and ETAs accurate and current on their own
- Surfaces risk, delay, and uncertainty early — and owns it when something slips
- Thinks in systems, not just tickets

If you prefer tightly scoped, short-term work, or want to stay inside a single framework, this won't be a good fit.

---

## ✅ Ideal Candidate

You:

- Are an **individual contributor** (not part of an agency or team)
- Have real experience with **headless CMS architectures and WordPress frontends**
- Can deploy, maintain, and debug sites on **Vercel and Linode**
- Understand search-first experiences and how **Typesense** fits into both architectures
- Write clean, maintainable code and can clearly explain your decisions
- Treat communication, reliability, and shared accountability as core parts of the job — not overhead
- Are comfortable working closely with a U.S.-based team, in real time, across time zones

---

## 📅 Scope & Structure

- Long-term role — not a short-term contract
- Large, complex, multi-month projects
- Frontend approach varies by project (Next.js vs. WordPress)
- The initial period is genuine mutual evaluation
- Strong performers grow in **responsibility, autonomy, and compensation**

---

## 🧠 How to Apply (No Boilerplate, Please)

Send a short note answering:

1. **Tell me about a project that took longer than expected.** How — and *when* — did you communicate the changes and manage expectations?
2. **Tell me about a time you fell behind, started late, or missed hours you'd committed to.** How did you handle it, and how did your manager or client find out?

title: Complete UI/UX Styling & Layout Polish for WooCommerce / GeneratePress Outdoor Store
description:
📄 Job Posting: Complete UI/UX Styling & Layout Polish for WooCommerce / GeneratePress Outdoor Store

📌 Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced WordPress / WooCommerce UI/UX Specialist to visually refine, polish, and build a unified design system for our outdoor gear brand (cadavia.com).

Our brand concept is simple: By pilgrims for pilgrims – specialized, highly functional gear designed for long-distance hikers and trail enthusiasts (featuring our flagship backpack bottle holder, water bottles, and upcoming gear additions).

The site is built natively on GeneratePress Premium + GenerateBlocks to guarantee maximum performance and zero code-bloat. The core pages and assets exist on our live site, serving as our base wireframe.

Your main goal is to elevate our existing setup into a sleek, high-converting, and seamlessly unified brand experience ("aus einem Guss") by designing global block templates and cohesive layouts across all core page types.

🎯 Key Scope & Deliverables

    Homepage & Brand Experience:

        Integrate our promo hero video seamlessly at the top.

        Polish section spacing, typography hierarchy, and brand story / USP displays.

    Scalable Single Product & Catalog Templates (WooCommerce):

        Single Product Template: Modern, conversion-focused layout including image gallery, Buy Box, USP icon bar, product bundle/cross-sell section, and feature matrix.

        Category / Shop Grid: Clean product cards featuring price badges, color variant indicators, and fast cart-addition triggers.

    Content & Trust Page Templates (Global Block Layouts):

        Blog / Single Post Template: High-readability typography layout with hero header, author box, related posts grid, and an in-content product callout card.

        Accordion FAQ Section & Page: Clean, stylish expandable FAQ section. Note: Must be built purely using native GenerateBlocks Accordions (NO third-party FAQ plugins).

        Brand Story Page Layout ("About Us"): Visual layout structure for text and image storytelling.

    Global Styling & Mobile Polish:

        Consistent design system (margins, paddings, high-contrast dark neutral base with sharp red accents matching our physical products).

        Mobile-First Optimization: Flawless usability and touch layout for mobile devices (80%+ of our traffic).

        Clean styling for mini-cart and checkout flow.

📦 Assets & Starting Point Provided by Us

    Existing live WordPress site structure functioning as the wireframe.

    Complete copy in English and Spanish.

    High-resolution studio & field photography + promotional video.

🛠️ Technical Requirements & Rules

    CMS/Engine: WordPress + WooCommerce.

    Framework: GeneratePress Premium & GenerateBlocks ONLY.

    Strict Rule: Zero heavy third-party page builders or heavy plugins (No Elementor, Divi, or dedicated FAQ plugins). Everything must use native Gutenberg / GenerateBlocks to maintain ultra-fast speed.

    Clean, modular CSS adjustments using global variables for effortless future updates.

👤 Ideal Candidate Profile

    Proven experience building/styling WooCommerce stores exclusively using GeneratePress & GenerateBlocks.

    Deep understanding of visual hierarchy, whitespace, micro-interactions, and high-converting D2C design.

💶 Project Scope & Fixed Budget

    Type: Fixed-Price Project

    Budget: $250 – $300 USD

    Turnaround: Fast and straightforward execution once assets and access are delivered.

❓ Screening Questions for Applicants

    "Have you built or styled WooCommerce stores using GeneratePress Premium & GenerateBlocks before? Please share 1–2 direct links to live sites you built using this stack."

    "Are you comfortable creating global block templates (e.g., for single product pages, blog posts, and native GenerateBlocks FAQ accordions) so future content automatically inherits the design system?"

title: Complete UI/UX Styling & Layout Polish for WooCommerce / GeneratePress Outdoor Store
description:
📄 Job Posting: Complete UI/UX Styling & Layout Polish for WooCommerce / GeneratePress Outdoor Store

📌 Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced WordPress / WooCommerce UI/UX Specialist to visually refine, polish, and build a unified design system for our outdoor gear brand (cadavia.com).

Our brand concept is simple: By pilgrims for pilgrims – specialized, highly functional gear designed for long-distance hikers and trail enthusiasts (featuring our flagship backpack bottle holder, water bottles, and upcoming gear additions).

The site is built natively on GeneratePress Premium + GenerateBlocks to guarantee maximum performance and zero code-bloat. The core pages and assets exist on our live site, serving as our base wireframe.

Your main goal is to elevate our existing setup into a sleek, high-converting, and seamlessly unified brand experience ("aus einem Guss") by designing global block templates and cohesive layouts across all core page types.

🎯 Key Scope & Deliverables

    Homepage & Brand Experience:

        Integrate our promo hero video seamlessly at the top.

        Polish section spacing, typography hierarchy, and brand story / USP displays.

    Scalable Single Product & Catalog Templates (WooCommerce):

        Single Product Template: Modern, conversion-focused layout including image gallery, Buy Box, USP icon bar, product bundle/cross-sell section, and feature matrix.

        Category / Shop Grid: Clean product cards featuring price badges, color variant indicators, and fast cart-addition triggers.

    Content & Trust Page Templates (Global Block Layouts):

        Blog / Single Post Template: High-readability typography layout with hero header, author box, related posts grid, and an in-content product callout card.

        Accordion FAQ Section & Page: Clean, stylish expandable FAQ section. Note: Must be built purely using native GenerateBlocks Accordions (NO third-party FAQ plugins).

        Brand Story Page Layout ("About Us"): Visual layout structure for text and image storytelling.

    Global Styling & Mobile Polish:

        Consistent design system (margins, paddings, high-contrast dark neutral base with sharp red accents matching our physical products).

        Mobile-First Optimization: Flawless usability and touch layout for mobile devices (80%+ of our traffic).

        Clean styling for mini-cart and checkout flow.

📦 Assets & Starting Point Provided by Us

    Existing live WordPress site structure functioning as the wireframe.

    Complete copy in English and Spanish.

    High-resolution studio & field photography + promotional video.

🛠️ Technical Requirements & Rules

    CMS/Engine: WordPress + WooCommerce.

    Framework: GeneratePress Premium & GenerateBlocks ONLY.

    Strict Rule: Zero heavy third-party page builders or heavy plugins (No Elementor, Divi, or dedicated FAQ plugins). Everything must use native Gutenberg / GenerateBlocks to maintain ultra-fast speed.

    Clean, modular CSS adjustments using global variables for effortless future updates.

👤 Ideal Candidate Profile

    Proven experience building/styling WooCommerce stores exclusively using GeneratePress & GenerateBlocks.

    Deep understanding of visual hierarchy, whitespace, micro-interactions, and high-converting D2C design.

💶 Project Scope & Fixed Budget

    Type: Fixed-Price Project

    Budget: $250 – $300 USD

    Turnaround: Fast and straightforward execution once assets and access are delivered.

❓ Screening Questions for Applicants

    "Have you built or styled WooCommerce stores using GeneratePress Premium & GenerateBlocks before? Please share 1–2 direct links to live sites you built using this stack."

    "Are you comfortable creating global block templates (e.g., for single product pages, blog posts, and native GenerateBlocks FAQ accordions) so future content automatically inherits the design system?"

title: WooCommerce and Elementor Store Setup
description:
I’m looking for someone experienced with WooCommerce and Elementor to help finish setting up an online store using a template that is already installed on the website.

The main design is already in place, so this project is mostly about configuring the store, organizing the products, and making sure everything looks professional and works smoothly for customers.

The project will include:

Creating and organizing five product categories
Adding three products to each category, for a total of 15 products
Setting up and organizing the store homepage
Configuring the main Shop page
Setting up the individual product pages
Adding product information, images, prices, descriptions, and variations provided by us
Configuring related products and recommended items
Adding recently viewed, featured, popular, or best-selling product sections
Setting up the cart, checkout, My Account, and order confirmation pages
Organizing the store menus, categories, search, and product filters
Making sure the website looks good on desktop, tablet, and mobile
Testing the full shopping process, from selecting a product through checkout

The store should follow common e-commerce standards and be simple and easy for customers to navigate.

I’m looking for someone who:

Has strong experience with WordPress, WooCommerce, and Elementor
Has worked with existing or preloaded website templates
Understands how to organize a professional online store
Has experience with product categories, attributes, variations, related products, and checkout settings
Pays attention to detail and communicates clearly
Can complete the setup without unnecessarily changing the existing design or branding

When applying, please include examples of WooCommerce websites you have worked on and briefly explain your experience with Elementor.

title: Meta Instagram API App Review Specialist for WordPress Website
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta Developer / Instagram API specialist to review our current integration on a WordPress website and help us obtain approval for the instagram_business_basic permission.

The OAuth flow is already implemented and appears to be working correctly. Users can connect their Instagram professional account, and the WordPress website retrieves the expected account data. However, Meta has rejected the App Review submission several times because the screencast allegedly does not align with the submitted use case.

The selected freelancer should:

- Review the Meta app configuration
- Audit the Instagram integration on our WordPress website
- Check the Instagram Business Login and OAuth flow
- Verify redirect URLs, permissions, access tokens, and callback handling
- Confirm that the requested permission matches the implemented functionality
- Review the screencast and reviewer instructions
- Improve the use-case description
- Identify the likely cause of the repeated rejection
- Help prepare and submit a new App Review request

The integration is already developed. We mainly need an expert to verify that the implementation is correct, confirm that OAuth works as expected, and help us align the submission with Meta’s review requirements.

title: Fix Meta Pixel / Conversions API Tracking Gap
description:

Audit my current Meta Pixel + Conversions API setup end-to-end (Bokun's tracking settings, Meta Events Manager, and my WordPress site if relevant)

    Homepage & Brand Experience:

    Global Styling & Mobile Polish:

        Mobile-First Optimization: Flawless usability and touch layout for mobile devices (80%+ of our traffic).

    Existing live WordPress site structure functioning as the wireframe.

    CMS/Engine: WordPress + WooCommerce.

title: Fix Meta Pixel / Conversions API Tracking Gap
description:
I run a boat tour business in Krabi, Thailand (krabisunsetcruises.com), and I'm running Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns to drive bookings. I need help diagnosing and fixing a data tracking gap between my Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI).

The problem: My Meta Events Manager shows Purchase events are being tracked by my browser-side Pixel (8 purchases in the last 7 days), but the server-side Conversions API is only capturing a fraction of those events (Meta's diagnostics report the server sending 6 fewer events than the pixel over a 7-day period). This is affecting my ad reporting accuracy and likely limiting how well Meta's ad delivery algorithm can optimize toward real bookings.

My setup:

Website: WordPress, hosted at krabisunsetcruises.com
Booking system: Bokun (bookings, checkout, and payment all happen through Bokun's platform)
Meta Pixel is already added inside Bokun's settings
Meta Business Manager / Ads Manager access will be provided

What I need:

Audit my current Meta Pixel + Conversions API setup end-to-end (Bokun's tracking settings, Meta Events Manager, and my WordPress site if relevant)
Identify exactly why Purchase events aren't being fully covered by CAPI (e.g., missing access token, incomplete event parameters, deduplication key issues — Meta's diagnostics specifically flagged "improving deduplication keys" as a possible fix)
Fix the gap so Purchase (and ideally other key events — ViewContent, InitiateCheckout, AddToCart) are reliably sent via both Pixel and CAPI with proper deduplication
Improve event match quality if possible (currently showing 6.1/10 — Meta flags this as "Great compared to similar advertisers" but room to improve)
Verify the fix using Meta's Test Events tool and confirm event match quality / coverage rate has improved
Provide a short written summary of what was wrong and what was changed, in plain language I can understand and refer back to

Nice to have:

Experience specifically with Bokun's marketing/tracking integrations (not just generic e-commerce platforms)
Experience with Meta Conversions API server-side implementations
Comfortable explaining technical fixes to a non-technical client

title: Build a WordPress/WooCommerce CSV Catalog Import Tool for Cabinet Products
description:
Build a WordPress/WooCommerce CSV Catalog Import Tool (Version 1)

Hello,

I'm the owner of a cabinetry company in the United States. My website is already built in WordPress with WooCommerce, and I'm looking for an experienced developer to create a reusable catalog import tool.

This is Version 1 of a larger catalog management system. My goal is to make manufacturer catalog updates something I can manage myself without needing a developer every time a manufacturer releases new products.

Current Website
WordPress
WooCommerce
Custom Theme
Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
Hoodsly Plugin Integration

The website is already operational. I'm now building internal tools that will allow me to manage and expand product catalogs efficiently.

What I Need

I would like a custom admin page where I can upload a standardized CSV file.

The importer should:

Create new WooCommerce products
Update existing products by SKU
Assign manufacturers
Assign product categories
Assign collections
Assign door styles
Assign colors/finishes
Import descriptions
Import specifications
Import dimensions
Associate product images using filenames (images will already exist in the WordPress Media Library)
Prevent duplicate products

The goal is to use this same importer whenever manufacturers release updated catalogs.

Manufacturers

The importer should be designed so I can continue adding manufacturers over time, including:

US Cabinet Depot
Carolina Heartwood
Bertch
Bishop
Additional manufacturers in the future

I don't want a one-time import. I want a reusable tool that I can continue using for years.

Future Phases (Not Included)

If Version 1 is successful, I would like to continue building additional features such as:

Image ZIP importing
Automatic category creation
Bulk catalog updates
Product relationships
Additional catalog automation
AI-assisted catalog management

I'm looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship.

Please Include

Please send examples of:

WooCommerce development
Custom WordPress plugins
CSV importers
WordPress admin tools

To confirm you've read this posting, please begin your proposal with:

CSV Cabinet Import

My budget for Version 1 is limited, but I'm investing in building a long-term system. If we work well together, I expect there will be many future projects as the website continues to grow.

* Phone number updated throughout every website.
* Fresh backups created.

## Requirements

* Extensive WordPress migration experience.

title: Website Theme Development
description:
Title: Senior Pure PHP / Custom WordPress Developer (Zero-Plugin / Hard-Coding Expert)

Description:

We are looking for an elite, senior-level PHP/WordPress engineer to architect and scaffold a high-performance, bespoke WordPress theme from scratch, based on our ready-to-use visual assets.

NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS: If your workflow relies on commercial heavy page builders (such as Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, etc.) or bloated commercial template kits, DO NOT APPLY. We require 100% hand-crafted, custom-coded architecture utilizing native WordPress APIs, pure PHP, clean modern JavaScript, and optimized SCSS/CSS.

Project Scope & Specifications:

1. Design Assets & Asset Handover (90% Visual Match): We possess full-fidelity screenshots, wireframes, and all necessary media assets (copy, imagery, and icons). The final UI/UX must achieve a ~90% strict visual parity with our provided reference layouts.

2. Surgical Modifications (15% Iterative Changes): A minor delta of ~15% structural or stylistic modifications will be requested against the base screenshots. Exact specifications, edge cases, and injection points for these modifications will be explicitly documented and handed over.

3. Strict Zero-Plugin Philosophy: The entire theme hierarchy (template parts, custom post types, dynamic modals, native preloaders, and component-driven layouts) must be hard-coded natively without relying on third-party design plugins or framework bloat.

4. Core Web Vitals & Performance Engineering: The build must pass Google PageSpeed Insights / Web Vitals with a 90+ score on both Mobile and Desktop (sub-second FCP/LCP, zero Cumulative Layout Shift [CLS]).

5. Dynamic CMS Extensibility (Backend): Implement a robust backend control layer using Native Custom Fields or a clean custom Options Panel. All typography, copy blocks, and asset pointers must be dynamically manageable via ⁠wp-admin⁠ with zero hard-coded content strings left in template files.

6. Code Quality & Security Standards: Adherence to WordPress PHP Coding Standards (WordPress Coding Standards - WPCS), strict input sanitization/escaping (⁠esc_html⁠, ⁠sanitize_text_field⁠), and a modular, object-oriented or well-scoped procedural codebase.

Strict Payment & QA Terms:

 100% Escrow Funding & Single Milestone: The full project budget will be fully funded into Upwork Escrow upfront. Zero funds will be released until the build is 100% production-ready, thoroughly unit/integration-tested, bug-free, and deployed live.

 Senior Code Audit & Quality Gate: Prior to milestone approval and fund release, the entire codebase will undergo a rigorous code review and static analysis inspection by our internal senior technical auditor for architectural integrity and compliance.

If you are a hardcore developer who takes pride in writing clean, scalable code and optimizing performance, drop your proposal with a brief explanation of how you approach custom theme architecture without third-party page builders.

title: Senior Laravel Engineer – AI API Integrations & Web Development
description:
Most real estate websites look the same and work the same — clunky search, outdated listings, zero intelligence. We're building something better. A modern property platform with smart AI features, clean UX, and a tech stack that can actually scale. Looking for a Laravel developer who wants to be part of this long-term.
We've got a solid idea of what we want but we need someone who actually knows what they're doing to build it and stick around long-term. This isn't a "build it and disappear" kind of job. We've got at least a year of work planned out and probably more after that.
The stack we're going with:
Laravel 11 on the backend. Tailwind CSS for styling. For the frontend interactivity we're thinking Livewire + Alpine.js but honestly if you've got a strong case for Vue or Inertia.js we're open to hearing it. MySQL or Postgres — you tell us what makes more sense for this type of project.
What we need built (starting stuff):
Property listings with search and filters — location, price range, bedrooms, property type, all that
Separate dashboards for buyers, sellers, and agents
Agent/agency profiles
Favorites, saved searches, email alerts when new properties match
Admin panel so we can manage everything — listings, users, reported content
Google Maps integration on listings
Mobile responsive obviously, Tailwind makes this easy
Role-based permissions — different users see different stuff
Image uploads and galleries for properties
Here's where it gets interesting — the AI stuff:
We want to integrate some AI features and this is a big part of why we're hiring now. Stuff like:
Listing description generator — agent puts in the basics (3 bed, 2 bath, renovated kitchen, whatever) and AI writes a proper listing description they can edit and publish. This alone will save agents hours.
Smart recommendations — show buyers properties based on what they've been looking at, not just random stuff
An AI chat widget on the site so visitors can ask questions about properties and get real answers instead of those terrible "leave your number and we'll call you" forms
Natural language search — someone types "family home near good schools under 400k" and it actually works
Maybe some market analysis stuff down the road — comparable properties, price trends by area
We'll be using OpenAI or Claude API for this. If you've integrated either before that's a huge plus.
What we're looking for in a developer:
Someone who's actually built real apps in Laravel. Not someone who watched a Udemy course last month. We want to see live projects or repos — show us what you've built.
You should be comfortable with:
Writing clean, well-structured Laravel code (proper migrations, seeders, form requests, policies — not everything dumped in controllers)
Frontend work with Tailwind — we don't want to hire a separate person for this
API integrations — maps, payment gateways, AI APIs
Git — we use it, you should too
Communicating like a normal person — if something's going to take longer, just tell us
Availability:
We need someone who can commit 20-30 hours a week. More is fine if we're in a heavy sprint. Less than 20 won't work — we need consistent momentum.
How we'll start:
We'll give you a small paid test task first. Nothing crazy — just want to see your code quality and how you communicate before we commit to a longer engagement. If it goes well we move to weekly milestones and keep going.
Budget:
$15-40/hr depending on where you're based and what you bring to the table. If you're amazing and your rate is a bit higher, still apply — we'd rather pay more for someone who doesn't need hand-holding.
When you apply please actually include:
Quick intro — who you are, where you're based, timezone
2-3 Laravel projects you've worked on (live links, GitHub, whatever — we want to see real stuff)
Have you worked with any AI/LLM APIs before? Which ones?
Your rate and how many hours/week you can do
When you can start
If you send a generic copy-paste proposal we'll skip it. We actually read these.

Thanks
